ar.name: لوح من العاج.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن لوح من العاج صُنع من رقائق مسطحة. يتراوح لون اللوح من البني الفاتح الى البني الرمادي (بفعل حريق تعرض له القصر قديماً). 90% من هذا اللوح العاجي ما زال موجوداً، وقد حُفر عليه بشكل بارز مشهد يمثل محارب يقف تحت مدخل قوس، ويرتدي على رأسه خوذة حربية، ويحمل بيديه بشكل أفقي ما يبدو كأنه صولجان أو رمح. ونحتت الزخارف على اللوح بدقة وبشكل دائري. أما أعلى نقطة من سطح الشكل فهي على نفس مستوى الإطار المحيط بالرسومات الذي زُخِرف بزخارف هندسية غنية.  
  
هناك فتحات صغيرة حُفرت في اللوح، وهناك بعض النتوءات، مما يدل على أن هذا اللوح وعدداً من الألواح المشابهة كانت متصلة مع بعضها البعض بواسطة مسامير حديدية، واستخدمت لزخرفة أبواب خزائن صغيرة في "غرفة الفريسكو" في قصر الأسرة العباسية في الحميمة. بنى الخلفاء العباسيون مطلبهم بالخلافة على أساس انتسابهم المباشر إلى العباس ابن عبد المطلب (566 – 652 م)، أحد أعمام الرسول عليه الصلاة والسلام، إذ اعتبروا أنفسهم الأحق بالخلافة وقاموا بالثورة على الخلافة الأموية.  
  
هذا اللوح يعتبر عنصر رفاهية، ويمكن أن نرى فيه تأثيرات فارسية وآسيوية وهندية وقبطية.
لوح عاجي، كان جزءاً من زخارف إحدى حجرات قصر عائلي عباسي، في الحميمة. بنقشه النافر يُشكِّل اللوح حاجة فاخرة، ذات علاقة أسلوبية بالفنون الفارسية، والآسيوية الوسطى، والهندية، والقبطية.
dates: النصف الأول من القرن 2 ﻫ/ 8 م.
keywords: أدوات رفاهية؛ ألبسة حربية؛ جندي؛ الرسول محمد؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ شكل آدمي؛ لوح عاجي؛ محارب؛ نحت بارز.

en.name: Ivory panel.
description:
An ivory panel that has been worked from a flat sheet; it varies in color from a very light brown to a rich brownish gray (burnt in antiquity). This panel is 90 per cent extant; carved in relief the scene represents a frontally disposed male figure standing in an archway. On his head, in profile, he is wearing military headgear. He holds in both his hands, vertically, what looks like either a long rod or an oar. The designs are carved carefully into the panel, in a vigorous, round style. The highest surface of the figure is at the same level as the surrounding frame, which is richly decorated with geometric motifs.  
  
Small holes have been drilled into the panel, along with some other perforations, suggesting that several of these panels were assembled together by iron fasteners to decorate the doors of a small cabinet in the 'fresco room' in the palace of the Abbasid family at al-Humayma.  
  
The Abbasid Caliphs based their claim to the caliphate on their direct descent from ‘Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib (AD 566–652) one of the youngest uncles of the Prophet Mohammad, by virtue of which they regarded themselves as the rightful heirs of the caliphate and overthrew the Umayyad caliphate. This panel is a luxury object that has stylistic affinities with Persian, central Asian, Indian and Coptic Art.

An ivory panel that was part of the decoration of a cabinet from the Abbasid family *qasr* (palace) at al-Humayma. Carved in relief, this is a luxury object that has stylistic affinities with Persian, central Asian, Indian and Coptic art.
dates: Hegira, first half of the 2nd century / AD first half of 8th century.
keywords: Armour; figurative representation; geometric motifs; luxury ware; military wear; Prophet Mohammad; relief decoration; soldier.

es.name: Placa de marfil
description:
Placa de marfil tallada sobre una lámina plana cuyo color varía desde un marrón muy claro hasta un marrón grisáceo (el objeto se quemó antiguamente). Se conserva el noventa por ciento de la placa. La escena representada, tallada en relieve, consta de una figura masculina de frente y de pie bajo un arco. Tiene la cabeza de perfil y lleva un tocado militar; sujeta con ambas manos un objeto vertical que parece una vara larga o un remo. Los dibujos están cuidadosamente labrados, en un estilo vigoroso de líneas redondeadas. La parte más prominente es del mismo grosor que el marco que la rodea, ricamente decorado con motivos geométricos.  
En la placa se aprecian pequeños agujeros y perforaciones, que sugieren que formaba parte de un conjunto de placas ensambladas con remaches de hierro. Seguramente decoraron las puertas de un armario pequeño de la “sala de los frescos” del palacio de la familia abbasí de al-Humayma.  
Los califas abbasíes reivindicaban su derecho al califato basándose en que eran descendientes directos de Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib (566-652 d. C.), uno de los tíos más jóvenes del profeta Muhammad. Se consideraban, por tanto, los herederos legítimos del califato y derrocaron el califato omeya. Esta placa es un objeto de lujo que comparte rasgos estilísticos con el arte persa, el centroasiático, el indio y el copto.

Placa de marfil que formó parte de la decoración de un armario del *qasr* (alcázar) de la familia abbasí en al-Humayma. Es un objeto de lujo tallado en relieve que guarda afinidades estilísticas con el arte persa, centroasiático, hindú y copto.
dates: Primera mitad del siglo II de la Hégira / primera mitad del siglo VIII d. C.
place: Hallado en al-Humayma, aunque se ignora el lugar de fabricación.
keywords: Armadura; representación figurativa; motivos geométricos; artículos de lujo; vestimenta militar; profeta Muhammad; relieve; soldado.

fr.name: Panneau d’ivoire.
description:
Plaque d'ivoire ouvragée. Sa couleur varie d'un brun très clair à un gris-brun soutenu (l'objet a été jadis brûlé). 10% de sa surface manquent. Une scène sculptée en relief représente une figure masculine vue de face sous une arche. La tête, vue de profil, porte un couvre-chef militaire. Le personnage tient verticalement entre ses deux mains ce qui ressemble à un long pieu ou une rame. Le travail de sculpture est délicat et vigoureux. La partie la plus en relief du personnage est de même épaisseur que le cadre qui l'entoure, lui-même richement décoré de motifs géométriques.  
De petits trous percés dans le panneau et d'autres perforations font penser que ce panneau faisait partie d'un ensemble de plaques similaires reliées par des attaches métalliques, qui décorait les portes d'un petit cabinet dans la “salle des fresques” du palais de famille abbasside à al-Houmayma.  
Les califes abbassides qui revendiquaient le califat en s'appuyant sur leur descendance directe d'Abbas ibn Abd al-Mouttalib (566-652 J.-C.), l'un des plus jeunes oncles de Mohamed, renversèrent les Omeyyades. Ce panneau est un objet de luxe qui présente des affinités stylistiques avec les arts perses, indiens, coptes et d'Asie centrale.

Panneau d’ivoire qui faisait partie de la décoration d’un cabinet du *qasr*(palais) familial abbasside à al-Houmayna. Sculpté en relief, ce panneau est un objet de luxe qui présente des affinités stylistiques avec les arts perses, indiens, coptes et d’Asie centrale.
dates: Première moitié du IIe siècle de l’Hégire (première moitié du VIIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: armures ; représentation figurative ; motifs géométriques ; produits de luxe ; tenues militaires ; le prophète Mahomet ; bas-relief ; soldats

en.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore, Pauline Chapel
description:
The chapel has a Greek cross floorplan and a dome, similar to its 25 years older "twin", the Sistine Chapel. The iconographic program was ideated by the Oratorian Cesare Baronio, who readapted many early Christian and martyrial Roman churches according to the Counter-Reformation’s precepts. Entirely covered with precious marble slabs and columns, with stucco, fresco and marble decorations, the chapel saw the participation of the major protagonists of the Roman art scene between Mannerism and Baroque.  
Above the altar of the sacred icon, Stefano Maderno sculpted the bas-relief with Pope Liberius tracing the perimeter of the Marian basilica in the snow. The lunette above the altar was frescoed by Cavalier d’Arpino and depicts, on one side, St. Gregory Thaumaturgus’s vision of the Virgin and St. John the Evangelist, and on the other a crowd bitten by the serpent of heresy, the temple of God and His believers.  
The dome hosts the Assumption of the Virgin, a fresco by Ludovico Cardi, known as Cigoli. The moon placed under the feet of the Madonna was painted with great scientific accuracy on the basis of the telescope images provided by Galileo Galilei, a friend of the painter.  
In the lower circle, overlooked by the Virgin, the Apostles are visible, while in the upper circle there are angelic hosts playing musical instruments, singing and strewing flowers.  
At the top of the small roof lantern God is depicted, ready to welcome the Virgin into heaven.  
The pendentives of the dome were frescoed by Cavalier d’Arpino and show the prophets Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel and Daniel. He also painted the altar arch with the holy bishops Ignatius, Theophilus, Irenaeus and Cyprian.  
On the sides of the chapel there are two funeral monuments: on the right that of Pope Clement VIII Aldobrandini, and on the left, that of Paul V. Both of them were sculpted by Silla da Viggiù.  
The side arches were frescoed by Guido Reni. Among the several saints that Reni painted, St. Dominic and St. Francis stand out for their dramatic force. Above the funeral monument to Paul V, Guido Reni painted the Eternal Father, too. The chapel’s exuberant decorations somewhat conceal the architectural structure designed by Flaminio Ponzio, thus becoming one of the first examples, together with the Sistine Chapel, of Baroque *horror vacui*.

Dedicated by Paul V to the Assumption of the Virgin. The iconographical program was drawn up by the Oratorian Cesare Baronio. Example of interaction of the arts and application of the Counterreformation’s rules.
artist: Flaminio Ponzio (architect); Stefano Maderno; Silla da Viggiù; Giuseppe Cesari known as Cavalier d’Arpino; Guido Reni; Ludovico Cardi known as il Cigoli
history:
Commissioned by Paul V immediately after his election, the chapel was created to offer a sumptuous architectural frame to the venerated, miraculous Marian icon known as *Salus Populi Romani,* which was, according to the tradition, painted by St. Luke the Evangelist, while probably a work of the early Christian age instead, and repainted around the 13th century.  
The Pauline Chapel, which mirrors the architecture of the opposite Sistine chapel, which had been commissioned by Sixtus V, cost about 230 *scudi,* an astronomical price for the time, which had to cover, in addition to the salaries of the several artistic workshops, also the purchase of the finest marbles, as well as expensive lapis lazuli used to frame the Marian icon. The consecration of the chapel took place in 1613, but the decoration was fully completed only in the following years.

it.name: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore, Cappella Paolina
description:
La cappella presenta una pianta a croce greca con cupola, analogamente alla sua “gemella” costruita 25 anni prima, la Cappella Sistina. Il programma iconografico si deve all’oratoriano Cesare Baronio, promotore di molti riadattamenti di chiese paleocristiane e martiriali romane in chiave controriformistica.  
Interamente rivestita di preziose lastre e colonne marmoree, con decorazioni in stucco, affresco e marmo, la cappella vide attivi i maggiori protagonisti della scena artistica romana tra Manierismo e Barocco.  
Al di sopra dell’altare della sacra icona, Stefano Maderno scolpì il bassorilievo con Papa Liberio nell’atto di tracciare nella neve il perimetro della basilica mariana.  
La lunetta al di sopra dell’altare fu affrescata dal Cavalier d’Arpino con, da una parte, la visione della Vergine e di San Giovanni Evangelista a San Gregorio Taumaturgo e dall’altra una folla morsa dal serpente dell’eresia, il tempio di Dio e i suoi fedeli.  
La cupola presenta l’Assunzione della Vergine, affrescata da Ludovico Cardi detto il Cigoli: la luna, posta sotto i piedi della Madonna, fu dipinta con grande esattezza scientifica sulla scorta dell’immagine che ne era stata rivelata dal telescopio di Galileo Galilei, amico del pittore. Nel girone più basso, su cui sorge la Vergine, sono visibili gli Apostoli mentre in quelli superiori schiere angeliche che suonano strumenti musicali, cantano e spargono fiori.  
Alla sommità del lanternino è raffigurato Dio Padre pronto ad accogliere in cielo la Vergine.  
I pennacchi della cupola furono affrescati dal Cavalier d’Arpino con le immagini dei profeti Isaia, Geremia, Ezechiele e Daniele e sempre il medesimo artista dipinse l’arcone dell’altare con i santi vescovi Ignazio, Teofilo, Ireneo e Cipriano.  
Ai lati della cappella sorgono due monumenti funebri: a destra quello di papa Clemente VIII Aldobrandini, opera di Silla da Viggiù e a sinistra, sempre del medesimo artista, di Paolo V. Entrambi i sottarchi laterali furono affrescati da Guido Reni (immagini di santi tra cui spiccano per forza drammatica San Domenico e San Francesco) e al di sopra del monumento a Paolo V sempre Guido Reni dipinse il Padre Eterno.  
La cappella per le sue esuberanti decorazioni finisce quasi con il nascondere l’architettura di Flaminio Ponzio e rappresenta uno dei primi esempi, insieme alla Cappella Sistina, di *horror vacui* barocco.

Dedicata da Paolo V all’Assunzione della Vergine, la cappella rappresenta la sontuosa cornice architettonica di una venerata icona della Madonna, oggetto di pellegrinaggio sin dal Medio Evo. L’affresco della cupola presenta, sotto i piedi della Madonna, la luna raffigurata dal Cigoli con scientifica precisione sulla scorta delle immagini che di essa erano state rivelate dal telescopio di Galilei, amico del pittore.
artist: Flaminio Ponzio (architetto); Stefano Maderno; Silla da Viggiù; Giuseppe Cesari detto Cavalier d’Arpino; Guido Reni; Ludovico Cardi detto il Cigoli
history:
Commissionata da Paolo V subito dopo la sua elezione, la cappella venne creata per offrire una sontuosa cornice architettonica alla veneratissima, miracolosa icona mariana nota come *Salus Populi Romani*, secondo la tradizione dipinta da San Luca Evangelista in realtà opera forse d'età paleocristiana, ridipinta intorno al XIII secolo.  
La cappella, rispecchiando fedelmente l'architettura dell'antistante cappella Sistina, voluta da Sisto V, costò la somma di 230 scudi circa, una cifra astronomica per l'epoca, che dovette coprire, oltre i costi per la varie maestranze artistiche, anche l'acquisto di marmi pregiatissimi, incluso il costoso lapislazzuli che incornicia l'icona mariana. La consacrazione della cappella si tenne nel 1613 ma la decorazione fu portata a compimento negli anni successivi.
keywords: Pellegrinaggio; Controriforma; scienza

en.name: Patriarchal College
short_description:
During his reign Gregory founded both the Patriarchal College in Beirut in 1865 and the Patriarchal College in Damascus in 1875 and re-opened the Melkite seminary of 'Ayn Traz in 1866. A western kind of architecture with balconies and balustrades.  
Gregory II Youssef founded the Patriarchal College in Beirut in 1865 as well as the Patriarchal College in Damascus in 1875 and re-opened the Melkit seminary of 'Ayn Trez in 1866. The college was built in a Western style, as seen by the use of balconies and balustrades.
history:
Each confession in Lebanon worked on spreading its beliefs and principals. Therefore, religiously based educational institutions were built. In this case the catholic Greek Church inaugurated the Patriarchal College in 1865, and still exists nowadays.  
Many religious education institutions were built in Lebanon, a multi-confessional country, with the aim of spreading the beliefs and principles of the respective confession. This Patriarchal College was inaugurated by the Catholic Greek church in 1865 and is still in use today.
keywords: Catholic-greek confession; School; College; Education

en.name: The Flood Tablet
short_description: Inspired by Layard’s discoveries, George Smith began to study cuneiform. His dedication was rewarded with the amazing discovery of a version of the Biblical Flood Story. The British Prime Minister came to his lecture. The news amazed the world. The Daily Telegraph financed an expedition to Nineveh to find the missing piece. Having found it, Smith died of fever on his way home.
keywords: archaeology; exploration; travel; traveller; collection; museums; cuneiform; inscription; clay; Gilgamesh; science

en.name: Konch
description:
The Konch is a fishing device made from bamboo and iron spikes, and is specifically designed to catch larger fish. It is similar to the Juti, but employs at least 10 pieces of bamboo splits, which are firmly fixed in a bunch. In order to increase its effectiveness, the tips of the bamboo are topped with sharp and pointed iron caps. To use it, fishermen must wait with great patience until they find a fish, often spending hours on a boat or at the water's edge. Once they eventually find one, they hurl the implement with great force, pinning the fish down and striking it. The species of fish caught with this device include Rui (Labeo rohita), Catla (Catla catla), Shoal (Channa striatus), and Gozar (Channa marulius), amongst others.  
Traditional fishing gear consists of a long bamboo handle (2-4m) with a 60-65cm iron rode at the base, and is fitted with multiple iron hooks at the apex. The iron rode is securely attached to the bamboo handle using coconut thread or iron wire.
keywords: Water; fishing gear; konch; teta

en.name: *The Grand Bazaar Istanbul*
short_description: This painting provides a fascinating insight into the activities within the Grand Bazaar of Istanbul during the 19th century CE. First built in the 15th century, its importance had declined somewhat in the 19th century, as non-Muslim merchants increasingly established independent shops in the European quarters of Istanbul rather than staying in the ‘outdated’ bazaar. Nevertheless, in 1890, there were still well over 4000 shops in the Bazaar. This image provides much detail about the appearance of traditional merchants and shops. Men, including some soldiers in European-style uniforms, and women in colourful local dress can be seen milling about the bazaar, their costume revealing important details about their ethnicity, profession and social status.
holder: Sharjah Art Museum / Sharjah Museums Department
keywords: bazaar

cs.name: Kašna Tritonů
description: Autorem je jako dalších kašen a sloupů olomoucký měšťan a kameník, inspirovaný obdobnou Berniniho kašnou v Římě. Olomoucká kašna představuje potomky a služebníky vládce moří Neptuna. Tritón, napůl člověk, napůl ryba, syn Neptuna a Amfitríté, troubil při bouřích na mušli. Původně kašna, jenž je tedy jakýmsi varováním před vodními živly, které na březích ramenatého toku řeky Moravy nebylo bez opodstatnění, tvořila dominantu rozcestí čtyř ulic.

en.name: Tritons’ Fountain
description: Václav Render, who also created several other fountains and columns, was an Olomouc burgher and stonemason, inspired by Bernini’s fountain in Rome. The Olomouc fountain represents the descendants and servants of Neptune, the ruler of the sea. Triton, half-man half-fish, son of Neptune and Amphitrite, would sound his conch if there was a storm at sea.The fountain may therefore symbolise a warning against the watery elements, far from unjustified in the vicinity of the mighty and unpredictable River Morava. The fountain originally dominated a crossroads.

en.name: Order of the Medjidie that belonged to Alexandru Ioan Cuza
short_description: In January 1859, Alexandru Ioan Cuza was elected prince of Moldavia and Wallachia despite the fact that in 1858 the suzerain power (the Ottoman Empire) and the Guaranteeing Powers (Russia, Austria, Prussia, France, Great Britain, Sardinia) had decided that the Principalities could unite, but were to have separate parliaments, governments and rulers. The double election was recognized by the Ottoman Empire in September 1859. The following year, Cuza travelled to Istanbul to introduce himself to the sultan. He crossed the Black Sea on an Ottoman ship sent for him. He had three meetings with the sultan, who decorated him with the order of the Medjidie and offered him a sword adorned with diamonds. One evening he was the sultan’s guest to a play performed in his private theatre at the Dolmabahçe palace.

ar.name: قطعة من زبدية
description: كسرة الزبدية مزينة بنقوش كتابية عربية بخط الثلث كتب عليها ""لساقي الأمير"" وعليها تصميم (شكل) كأس أولي الشكل .والأحرف والكأس مطليان بظلال من البني أو الأبيض وحدودهما الخارجية محززة .وفوق النقش الكتابي يوجد  تدوين ذو لفة محززة. والشكل مكرر في الفن المملوكي وتظهر الرنكات على كلا القطعتين ومجموعة كبيرة من القطع (أسلحة ودروع ، خزف ، زجاج ، مشغولات معدنية وأقمشة ) . يعرف حوالي خمسين من مثل هذه الرنكات حاليا حيث تترافق بنقوش كتابية تحدد اسم صاحبها ويمكن متابعة أصلها لشخصية تاريخية والرنكات الأخرى تفسر بشكل أعم ، على المستوى الرمزي ، وأشكال الحيوانات (الأسد ، النسر ) كانت في بعض الأحيان جزءا من رنك السلطان بينما الأشكال الأخرى كانت مرتبطة بمناصب شغلها المماليك في حاشية السلطان : الكأس للساقي ونوادي البولو لمعلم (المسؤول عن ) البولو (الجوكندر) والسيف ،القوس أو الصولجان لمسؤول السلاح (سلحدار ) واللوزنج ( البقجة) لمسؤول الثياب (جامدار).

en.name: Bowl fragment
description: The bowl fragment is decorated with an Arabic inscription in *thuluth* calligraphy reading *‘li'l muhamir al-amir’* (‘to the prince’s cupbearer’) and a heraldic cup motif. The letters and the cup are painted in shades of brown or in white, their outlines are incised. Above the inscription, a narrow register with an incised scroll. A recurrent motif in Mamluk art, blazons were displayed on both monuments and a large variety of objects (arms and armour, ceramics, glass, metalwork, and textiles). Around fifty such blazons are currently known; when accompanied by inscriptions identifying the name of the commissioner they could be actually traced back to a historical personality; others were interpreted on a more general, symbolic level. Animal motifs (the lion, the eagle) were sometimes part of a sultan’s blazon, whilst other motifs were associated with offices held by Mamluks in the sultan’s entourage: the cup with the cupbearer (*saqi*), the polo clubs with the polo master (*jukandar*), the sword, the bow or the mace with the arms bearer (*silahdar*), the lozenge (*buqja*) with the master of the robes (*jamdar*).
holder: The National Museum of Art of Romania
keywords: Blazon
materials: Incised (*sgrafitto*) red earthenware, white slip, painted in two browns and in white under a yellow glaze

en.name: *Anna Maria Victoria Jabornigg-Gamseneck*
description:
A portrait of a finely dressed and learned noblewoman in an ermine pelisse, she sits on a chair by a table on which are geometrical implements, several books and some sheets of paper.  
The painting is thought to be a portrait of Maria Victoria Jabornigg Gamsenegg, the first wife of Josip Ignac Sigismund Hilleprand-Prandau, son of Petar II Anton.  
Attributed to Ephraim Hochhauser who studied at the Vienna Academy and made his name painting portraits of the aristocracy, perhaps the identity of the sitter in this case is less important than the context. The woman holding compasses in her hand sits in front of sheets of drawing paper, a ruler and protractor. At the time, geometry was an acceptable form of entertainment for amateurs and seen as part of a good education. With a little freedom of thought, we might link these items with the laying out of the Baroque *parterre* garden in front of Valpovo Manor.  
The History Gallery of the Hungarian National Museum in Budapest has an identical portrait, which according to researchers represents Maria Christina the beloved daughter of Empress Maria Theresia, and attributed to the court painter Martin van Meytens who was a great favourite of the Empress. Since Petar II Hilleprand-Prandau was in the diplomatic service of the Austrian Court, it is possible that a portrait of the Empress's daughter found its way to Valpovo Manor.

A portrait of a finely dressed and learned noblewoman, which according to the Prandau family archive, is a portrait of Anna Maria Victoria – the first wife of Josip Ignac – son of Petar II Anton.  
There is an identical portrait in the History Gallery of the Hungarian National Museum by Martin van Meytens, which according to researchers shows Maria Christina, daughter of Empress Maria Theresia.  
Perhaps the identity of the sitter in this case is less important than the context, for the woman holding compasses in her hand sits amidst sheets of drawing paper, a ruler and protractor. At the time, geometry was an acceptable form of entertainment for amateurs and seen as part of a good education. With a little freedom of thought, we might link these items with the laying out of the Baroque *parterre* garden in front of Valpovo Manor.

ar.name: لوح من محراب.
description:
لوح من منبر مع إطار من الخشب الأحمر الحديث، وهو مستطيل الشكل، له حقل مركزي واسع من العناصر الهندسية الأصلية المنفذة بالأبنوس والعاج على إطار من الخشب الأحمر الحديث. يتضمن التصميم شكلين نجميين في المركز، يفصل بينهما تصميم هندسي رباعي الفصوص، ويحد هذا التشكيل نصفا نجمة على الجانبين وأربع أرباع نجمة في الزوايا، وقد تم ملء الفراغات المتبقية بنماذج نجمية. تم خلق جميع العناصر الرئيسة في التصميم كالنجوم ورباعي الفصوص، من أشكال نجمية، وأشكال ذات زوايا منحدرة، ومجموعة من الأشكال متعددة الأضلاع، وقد تمت زخرفة كل منها بتصميم من الأرابيسك المشغول بعناية. وفي أعلى وأسفل الحقل الأساس، تم إدراج لوحتين طولانيتين ضيقتين من الأبنوس المحدد بالعاج، تحمل كل منهما النقش العربي نفسه بالخط الثلث: "العز لله مولانا السلطان الملك العادل".  
درجت العادة على تزيين القطع كهذا اللوح بنماذج من النجوم والأشكال متعددة الأضلاع المنفذة بأنواع مختلفة من الخشب والعاج، وقد بدأ هذا التقليد في الفترة الأيوبية، واستمر قيد الاستخدام خلال الفترة المملوكية. تألفت التشكيلات من تصاميم هندسية منبثقة من شكل نجمي مركزي يتراوح عدد رؤوسه بين 6 و16، مشكلاً مجموعة من الأشكال المتعددة الأضلاع التي تنبثق من القلب. وقد تطور هذا النوع من التشكيلات النجمية مع بداية القرن الثامن/ الرابع عشر، وأصبح الشكل الأكثر استعمالاً لأعمال الزخرفة الخشبية خلال الفترة المملوكية.  
سمحت الطريقة التي تم استخدامها في تصنيع هذا اللوح وغيره من القطع من هذه الفترة للخشب بأن يتمدد ويتقلص حسب درجات الحرارة والرطوبة. وقد عكست النماذج المستخدمة في الأعمال الخشبية في تلك الفترة أغلفة الكتب وزخارف المخطوطات المملوكية المنفذة لصالح البلاط المملوكي وضباطه. وبالإضافة إلى الأشكال المتعددة الأضلاع والنجوم المحفورة بشكل معقد، يعتبر النقش المنفذ بالخط الثلث صفة مميزة أخرى للأعمال المملوكية الخشبية، وللفنون الزخرفية المملوكية بشكل عام.

كانت الأعمال الخشبية المحفورة، المُتقنة، ذوات التصاميم الهندسية المُعقَّدة، المُنفَّذة على الأبنوس والعاج والمُدعَّمة بألواح عليها كتابات رشيقة محفورة بخطِّ الثلث، تُنفَّذ تلبية لطلبات على امتداد الفترة المملوكية، تحسيناً لقطع أثاث المساجد، والأضرحة، والمباني العامة، في طول الدولة المملوكية وعرضها.
holder: المتحف الملكي، المتحف الوطني في اسكتلندا NMS.
dates: أواخر الثامن- أوائل التاسع/ أواخر الرابع عشر- أوائل الخامس عشر.
keywords: خشب؛ خط ثلث؛ عاج؛ منبر.
materials: أبنوس وعاج مع إطار من الخشب الأحمر الحديث.
tags: أبنوس وعاج مع إطار من الخشب الأحمر الحديث.

en.name: *Minbar* panel.
description:
A *minbar* panel with a modern redwood frame. Rectangular in shape, the panel contains a large, central field of original geometric elements executed in ebony and ivory, set within modern redwood beading. The design of the field involves two large vertically disposed star shapes at the centre, separated by a geometric quatrefoil design in between. This arrangement is flanked by two semi-stars on the sides and four quarter-stars in the corners. Any remaining spaces are filled with regularly disposed star motifs. All the major design elements in this overall composition, for example the stars and the quatrefoil, are in turn created from star shapes, angular drop shapes and a range of polygons, each one enhanced with a delicately carved arabesque design. At the top and bottom of the main field, two narrow, elongated ebony panels with ivory borders have been inserted. Each one carries the same Arabic inscription, rendered in *thuluth* script: ‘al-‘izz lillah mawlana al-sultan al-malik al-‘adil’, (‘Glory to God, our Lord, the Sultan, the King, the Just’).  
Furnishings such as this panel were typically decorated with star and polygon patterns executed in different woods and ivory. This tradition, begun in the Ayyubid period, remained in use throughout the Mamluk period. Compositions comprise geometric designs issuing from a central star motif with the number of points varying from six to 16, forming a series of radiating polygons expanding from the core. This type of astral composition was fully developed by the early 8th / 14th century and became the most typical approach for woodwork decoration in the Mamluk era.  
The method of construction used in this panel, along with other such objects of the period, allowed the wood to expand and contract according to variations in temperature and humidity. Furthermore, the patterns adopted in woodwork of the period echo contemporary Mamluk bookbinding and manuscript illumination executed for or commissioned by the Mamluk court and its officials. In addition to the intricately carved polygons and stars, the inscription panel executed in bold *thuluth* script is another distinctive feature of Mamluk woodwork, as indeed it is of Mamluk decorative arts in general.

Sophisticated woodwork with complex geometric designs executed in ebony and ivory and enhanced with delicately carved *thuluth* inscription panels was commissioned throughout the Mamluk period to enhance the furnishings of mosques, mausoleums and public buildings all over the Mamluk empire.
dates: Hegira late 8th–early 9th century / AD late 14th–early 15th century.
keywords: Minbar; wood; thuluth; ivory; Mosque interior decoration
materials: Ebony and ivory with modern redwood beading.
tags: Ebony and ivory with modern redwood beading.

es.name: Panel de *minbar*.
description:
Panel rectangular de *minbar* con armazón moderno de secoya que enmarca un gran campo geométrico central realizado en ébano y marfil. El diseño consiste en dos grandes estrellas dispuestas en vertical con un cuadrifolio entre ellas, dos medias estrellas a los lados de este y cuatro cuartos de estrella en los ángulos. Los espacios restantes se rellenan con piezas angulosas poligonales (azafates, almendrillas, etc.) que completan el lazo. Todos estas piezas, así como las estrellas y el cuadrifolio, están finamente talladas con arabescos. En la parte superior del panel se insertan dos rectángulos de ébano con junquillos de marfil y otros dos en la parte inferior; en todos ellos se repite una inscripción en caligrafía *zuluz*: “al-‘izz lillah mawlana al-sultan al-malik al-‘adil” (“Gloria a Dios, nuestro Señor, el Sultán, el Rey, el Justo”).  
Este tipo de mobiliario se decoraba usualmente con lacería ejecutada en madera y marfil. Tradición ayyubí en origen, se mantuvo durante todo el periodo mameluco. Las composiciones irradian de una estrella central de entre seis y dieciséis puntas y van dando lugar a polígonos de diversas formas y tamaños. Esta clase de composiciones estrelladas se desarrolló plenamente a principios del siglo VIII / XIV y pasó a ser la más común de la decoración en madera del periodo mameluco.  
La técnica de construcción empleada en este panel, y en otros trabajos de la época, permitía que la madera se contrayera o contrajera según la temperatura y la humedad. Además, los diseños que aparecen en la carpintería de este periodo reproducen los de encuadernaciones e iluminaciones de manuscritos contemporáneas. Otro rasgo característico, aparte de la intrincada talla, es la inscripción en gruesa letra *zuluz*, rasgo que puede extenderse a las artes decorativas mamelucas en general.

Durante el periodo mameluco se encomendaron sofisticados trabajos en madera, decorados con complicados diseños en ébano y marfil y delicadas inscripciones en letra *zuluz*, para enriquecer el mobiliario de mezquitas, mausoleos y edificios públicos en todo el imperio.
dates: Finales del siglo VIII-principios del IX de la Hégira/ finales del XIV-principios del XV d. C.
keywords: minbar; madera; inscripción zuluz; marfil
materials: Ébano y marfil con armazón moderno de secoya.
tags: Ébano y marfil con armazón moderno de secoya.

fr.name: Panneau de minbar.
description:
Panneau de *minbar* sur ossature moderne en bois rouge. De forme rectangulaire, il contient un important élément central composé de formes géométriques d'origine en ébène et ivoire et montées dans l'ossature récente. La composition de la partie centrale comprend, au centre, deux grandes étoiles disposées verticalement, séparées par des motifs de quatre-feuilles géométriques. Cette disposition est flanquée sur les côtés par deux demi-étoiles et quatre quarts d'étoile aux angles. Les espaces restants sont occupés par des motifs en forme d'étoile régulièrement répartis. La totalité des principaux éléments de la composition, comme les étoiles et le quatre-feuilles, s'inspirent de motifs d'étoiles, de gouttes et de polygones, chacun mis en valeur par un délicat travail d'arabesques sculptées. En haut et en bas du champ principal, deux étroits panneaux allongés en ébène à bordures d'ivoire ont été insérés. Chacun porte la même inscription en écriture *thoulouth*: “\[Gloire à\] notre Seigneur, le Sultan, le Roi, le Juste.”  
Les éléments de décor en bois comme ce panneau étaient typiquement ornés de motifs d'étoiles et de polygones exécutés en ivoire et dans différentes variétés de bois. Cette tradition, initiée sous les Ayyoubides, resta en vigueur tout au long de la période mamelouke. Les compositions comprenaient des motifs géométriques se déployant à partir d'une étoile centrale de six à seize branches, formant une série de polygones à partir de ce noyau central. Ce type de composition astrale était pleinement développé au début du VIIe siècle H (XIVe siècle J.-C.) et devint le style décoratif le plus caractéristique du travail du bois mamelouk.  
La méthode de construction utilisée pour ce panneau, ainsi que pour d'autres objets de la période, permettait au bois de se dilater ou de se comprimer en fonction des variations de température et d'hygrométrie. Les motifs décoratifs adoptés pour le travail du bois se retrouvaient également dans la reliure et les enluminures mameloukes de la période, exécutées ou commandées par la cour. En dehors des étoiles et des polygones imbriqués, le panneau épigraphique en écriture *thoulouth* est lui aussi caractéristique du travail du bois mamelouk, comme des arts décoratifs mamelouks en général.

D’élégantes pièces de bois ornées de complexes dessins géométriques en ébène et ivoire et rehaussées d’un panneau d’inscriptions en *toulouth* délicatement gravées furent commanditées durant toute la période mamelouke pour embellir le mobilier des mosquées, des mausolées et des édifices publics à travers tout l’empire mamelouk.
dates: Fin VIIIe-début IXe siècles de l’Hégire (fin XIVe-début XVe siècles J.-C.).
keywords: minbar ; bois : écriture thoulouth ; ivoire.
materials: Ébène et ivoire, ossature moderne en bois rouge.
tags: Ébène et ivoire, ossature moderne en bois rouge.

en.name: Mosque-lamp-shaped vessel with Arabic inscriptions
description: With its delicate spiralling stem design, this small vessel belongs to a group of ceramics formerly referred to as "Golden Horn" wares. Current scholarship, however, prefers the term *tughrakes*\-, or "*tughra*‑illuminator" style for such decoration, comparing its design to the fine swirling vines adorning *tughra* calligraphies. During this period, pottery shapes often imitated metalwork forms. This piece, however, emulates glass mosque lamps, which often displayed Arabic inscriptions.

ar.name: فسقية للوضوء.
description: فسقية للوضوء مثمّنة الشكل. حُفر الداخل مع الأطراف المؤطرة في الأعلى وفي الخارج؛ ويبدو على الفسقية ثقب لحقها فيما بعد، وبُترت القاعدة وتنقصها ساق أو رجل صغيرة. تقدم الحافة الخارجية زخارف تتكون من عناصر هندسية صغيرة الحجم، محفورة (معيّنات، مربّعات ودوائر)، في حين تحتوي الحافة العليا على طول محيطها على نقيشة عربية بالخط الكوفي، يمكن أن نقرأ فيها كلمة "الملك" التي تتكرر دون انقطاع.

تقدم هذه الفسقية الخاصة بالوضوء ذات الشكل المثمن والمنقوشة في حجر كلسي محلي الدليلَ على تواجد طويل لجماعة إسلامية بلشبونة. اكتشفت القطعة خلال أشغال ترميم الحي المغربي للشبونة، في المسجد الذي كانت تنتمي إليه.
keywords: الملك؛ حجر مجيّر؛ فسقية للوضوء؛ كتابة كوفية.

en.name: Font.
description: Font with eight lobes. The inside is hollowed out, with the rim moulded on the top and on the outside. It has a hole at the bottom. The base is truncated, with a base or foot missing. The exterior moulding has a decoration of small engraved geometric patterns (lozenges, squares and circles). The upper rim has an Arabic inscription in *kufic* script running all the way round, in which it is possible to read the expression ‘al-Mulk’, repeated in a chain.

The evidence for the prolonged presence of a Muslim community in Lisbon is supported by this octagonal ablutions font sculpted from local *pedra lioz* (lias) limestone. It was found during restoration work in Lisbon’s Moorish quarter, to whose mosque it belonged.
keywords: font; lias stone; Kufic script; al-mulk

es.name: Pila de abluciones.
description: Pila de abluciones ochavada, de interior excavado y con borde moldurado superior y en el exterior. Presenta una perforación posterior. En la base, partida, falta el pedúnculo o pie. La moldura exterior está decorada con pequeños elementos geométricos esculpidos (rombos, cuadrados y círculos). El borde superior presenta en todo su perímetro una inscripción cúfica en la que es posible leer la expresión *al-mulk*, repetida de forma encadenada.

La prolongada presencia de una comunidad musulmana en Lisboa está bien atestiguada a través de esta pila de abluciones ochavada, esculpida en piedra caliza liásica local. Se encontró durante las obras de rehabilitación de la morería lisboeta, a cuya mezquita pertenecería.
dates: Siglo VIII o IX de la Hégira / XIV-XV d. C.
keywords: Cúfica; al-mulk.

fr.name: Vasque à ablutions.
description: Vasque à ablutions octogonale. L'intérieur est creusé, avec les bords encadrés au-dessus et à l'extérieur. Présente une perforation postérieure. La base est tronquée, il lui manque un pédoncule ou un pied. La bordure extérieure présente un décor à éléments géométriques de petite taille (losanges, carrés et cercles), gravés. Le bord supérieur présente sur tout le périmètre une inscription arabe, en graphie coufique, sur laquelle on peut lire l'expression *al-mulk*, répétée en continu.

La preuve de la présence prolongée d'une communauté musulmane à Lisbonne est apportée par cette vasque à ablutions de forme octogonale sculptée dans le calcaire d'origine locale. Elle fut découverte pendant les travaux de restauration du quartier maure de Lisbonne, à la mosquée duquel elle appartenait.
dates: VIIIe-IXe siècle de l’Hégire (XIVe-XVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: vasque à ablutions ; pierre de liais ; graphie coufique ; al-mulk

pt.name: Pia de abluções.

O bordo superior apresenta a todo o perímetro uma inscrição árabe, em grafia cúfica, da qual é possível ler a expressão *al-mulk*, repetida de forma encadeada.

A prolongada presença de uma comunidade muçulmana em Lisboa está bem atestada através desta pia de abluções oitavada, esculpida na pedra lioz local. Foi encontrada durante obras de reabilitação, no bairro da mouraria (Lisboa), a cuja mesquita terá pertencido. Data dos séculos VIII-IX AH / XIV-XV AD.

The Museum of Islamic Art’s collection of carpets is one of the most important in the world. It was started in 1904 with the gift of 21 carpets from Wilhelm von Bode. The important carpet no 1 burned partially 1945 and was restored partially with fragments later. This specific artwork was created in the North West of Iran before the middle of the 16th century and shows an animated scene featuring animals and trees.

en.name: *Tawa* (Roasting pan)
description:
*Tawa* (roasting pan) used to roast coffee beans.  
Coffee is always served at the beginning of a visit and is repeatedly offered until guests politely signal that they have had enough by rocking their cup from side to side. In order to keep coffee hot and fresh for unexpected guests it goes through many stages. After roasting and grinding the coffee beans the grains are added to boiling water inside a large *dallah* (coffee pot) called a *khamra*. Next, the liquid is poured into a medium-sized coffee pot called a *taljeemah*. At this stage cardamom seeds, saffron and rose water may be added for flavour. From this jug, the coffee is poured into a serving dallah referred to as a mezallah, where the coffee is refined and filtered. The server must hold the *mezallah* with their left hand and distribute the fanayeel (coffee cups) using the right hand. The coffee should fill less than half of the cup.
dates: Hegira mid 14th century / AD mid 20th century
keywords: roasting pan; pan; coffee; coffee beans

ar.name: ايكات معلقة
description:
تم تنفيذ زخرفة هذا المعلقة الجدارية باستخدام تقنية الإيكات، وهي تصور أحد أشهر الديكورات في فترة القاجار: أشجار السرو في كوة. علاوة على ذلك، في هذا المثال بالذات، تمت إضافة شكل شائع آخر، وهو الطاووس، إلى أطراف أشجار السرو الصغيرة. وقد بقيت المعلقات الجدارية المماثلة المصنوعة من إيكات الحريربشكل رئيسي في يزد، ومن هنا مصدرها المحتمل.  
  
ظهر نسج الإيكات بشكل متقطع في إيران في وقت مبكر من القرنين السابع عشر والثامن عشر، لكنها ظلت الاستثناء الكبير. في القرن التاسع عشر، وخاصة في النصف الثاني، ازدهر نسج الإيكات، وشهد فترة من التطور الفني. خلال هذه الفترة، شكلت الواردات المتزايدة باستمرار من السلع الأوروبية الرخيصة المصنعة آليًا مشاكل هائلة لمصنعي المنسوجات المحليين. ومع ذلك، تمكن نساجو الإيكات من الصمود بنجاح في مواجهة المنافسة.
materials: سداة ايكات, حرير, البطانة: قطن أوروبي مطبوع
tags: سداة ايكات, حرير, البطانة: قطن أوروبي مطبوع

en.name: Ikat hanging
description:
The decoration of this wall hanging has been achieved through the ikat technique, and depicts one of the most popular décors of the Qajar period: cypresses in a niche. Further to this, in this particular example another popular motif, the peacock, has been added to the tips of the small cypresses. Comparable wall hangings made of silk ikat have survived mainly from Yazd, hence its likely provenance.  
  
Ikat weavings appeared sporadically in Iran as early as the 17th and 18th centuries, but remained the great exception. In the 19th century, especially in the second half, ikat weaving flourished, experiencing a period of artistic development. During this period, the ever increasing imports of cheap European machine-made goods posed enormous problems for local textile manufacturers. However, the ikat weavers were able to successfully hold their own against the competition.
materials: Warp ikat, silk, lining: European printed cotton
tags: Warp ikat, silk, lining: European printed cotton

ar.name: دينار.
description:
هذه قطعة نقدية صليبيّة بقيمة دينار مصنوعة من ذهب. رغم أن الصليبين قدموا محاربين ضد الإسلام، إلا أنهم استوطنوا في البلاد وعملوا بالتجارة بشكل واسع. وقد سكّوا نقوداً مشابهة للنقود المتعارف عليها في المنطقة لتكون مقبولة ومتداولة. وهذه القطعة من هذه النقود. وهي عبارة عن دينار صليبي على النمط الفاطمي، أي أن الكتابة منقوشة في ثلاث دوائر متّحدة المركز. ضرب هذا الدينار بعكا سنة 649 / 1251، في الفترة التي كان الملك الفرنسي لويس التاسع في الشرق يقود الحملتين الصليبيتين السابعة والثامنة. بدأ سك هذه النقود حين وصل قاضي باباوي جديد إلى الولايات اللاتينية في ربيع سنة 1250م، فحرّم على الفرنجة سك نقود تحتوي على أسماء الخلفاء أو اسم الرسول، وبدّلها بهذه النقود الجديدة ذات العبارات والرموز المسيحية المكتوبة بالعربية قصداً، ولكنها تحتوي على أخطاء لغوية. سُجِّلت النصوص الكتابية على هذا النقد بالخط النسخي.  
  
يظهر على وجه القطعة كتابة تقع في طوقين وفي وسط القطعة، وهي على النحو التالي:  
الطوق الأول: "الأب والابن والروح القدس"  
الطوق الثاني (الخارجي): "ضرب بعكا سنة ألف ومائتين وواحد وخمسين، تجسد ربنا"، ويلي هذه العبارة صليب على جانبيه نقطتين.  
الوسط: تظهر ضمن دائرة عبارة إله واحد، وقد كتبت "إلاه واحد".  
  
يظهر على ظهر القطعة كتابة تقع أيضاً في طوقين وفي وسط القطعة، وهي على النحو التالي:  
الطوق الأول: يظهر صليب صغير وعلى كل جانب منه نقطتان، ويقع فوق الصليب الذي في الدائرة الوسطى، يليه العبارة "وقيامتنا وبه تخلصنا وعافنا".  
الطوق الثاني: يظهر على المحيط شكل صليب (غير واضح) منقوط على جانبيه، ثم عبارة "نفتخر بصليب ربنا يسوع المسيح الذي به سلامنا".  
الوسط: يظهر ضمن دائرة شكل صليب منقوط عند الزاويتين المتقابلتين اليسرى من الأعلى، واليمنى من الأسفل.  
  
أخيراً، يجب القول أن كثيراً من الكلمات المدوَّنة على هذه القطعة تنقصها بعض الأحرف، وأن هناك صعوبة في قراءة النص نظراً لوجود أخطاء.

قطعة نقد ذهبية (دينار)، تمَّ إصداره في أكري. للحفاظ على الاقتصاد قام الفرنجة بصكّ القطع النقدية، وفق الطراز الإسلامي، باتباع النظام الفاطمي في النقوش العربية، المترتبة في ثلاث دوائر متتالية، بالإضافة إلى صليب يتوسَّط القطعة.
keywords: الأيوبيون؛ دينار؛ ذهب؛ صليب؛ الصليبيون؛ عكا؛ الفاطميون؛ مسكوك؛ الملك لويس التاسع؛ نقود؛ عملة؛ علم العملة

en.name: *Dinar* (gold coin).
description:
A Crusader coin, with the value of a *dinar* as it is made of gold. Although the Crusaders came as counter-Islamic warriors, they also settled in the region and engaged in commerce quite extensively. In order for their coins to have value and be recognisable within the market economy, they minted coins similar to the ones found in the region and inscribed their minting in Arabic. This coin follows a Fatimid prototype. Its inscription is arranged in three concentric circles. It was minted in Acre in AD 1251 (AH 649), during the rule of King Louis IX (d. AD 1270), the King of France who led the 7th and 8th crusades. The minting of these coins was instigated by the arrival of a new papal legislator to the Latin states in the spring of 1250 who considered it blasphemous to use coins containing the names of the Muslim prophets and the ruling caliphs. He immediately forbade their minting, replacing them with coins portraying Christian symbolism written in deliberate but faulty Arabic language.  
The following Arabic inscriptions are recorded on the coin in *naskhi* script:  
Obverse  
Middle – the phrase “God is one” is written, although the Arabic word for God (Ilah) is misspelled.  
Inner Ring – “The Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit”  
Outer Ring – “Minted in Acre in the year one thousand two hundred and fifty one, our Lord became incarnate.” This phrase is followed by a cross flanked by two dots.  
Reverse  
Middle – In the middle of a circle is a cross with dots in opposite quadrants; the upper left and lower right.  
Inner Circle – There is a small cross flanked by a pair of dots on each side, located in proximity to the cross in the middle circle. The inscription reads, “Our resurrection, our salvation is in Him, protect us”.  
Outer Circle – On the perimeter is an unclear form of a cross with one dot on each side, then the phrase “We are proud of the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in Him is our peace”.  
Note that a number of the words are misspelled and the text has numerous linguistic errors, which makes it difficult to read.

This gold coin, known as a *dinar*, was minted by the Crusader settlers in Acre. To maintain economic viability the Crusaders minted coins in the Islamic numismatic style, following the Fatimid prototype of Arabic inscriptions arranged in three concentric circles, with the addition of a central cross.
keywords: coin; coinage; dinar; gold; minted; Crusader; Acre; Fatimids; Louis IX; Christ; numismatics

es.name: Moneda de oro (dinar).
description:
Moneda de oro de los cruzados con el valor de un dinar. Aunque los cruzados llegaron a la zona como combatientes contra el islam, se establecieron allí y emprendieron una importante actividad comercial. Para que su dinero tuviera valor y fuera admisible mercantilmente, acuñaron monedas con texto en árabe, similares a las de la zona. Esta moneda sigue el patrón fatimí, ya que su inscripción está dispuesta en tres círculos concéntricos. Se acuñó en Acre en 1251 (649 de la Hégira), durante el reinado de Luis IX (m. 1270), el rey de Francia que encabezó la séptima y la octava cruzadas. El instigador de la acuñación de este tipo de monedas fue un legislador papal de los estados latinos que, en la primavera de 1250, consideró que usar monedas con los nombres de los profetas musulmanes y los califas gobernantes era una blasfemia. Prohibió de inmediato su acuñación y las remplazó por monedas que presentaban símbolos cristianos y textos escritos deliberadamente en árabe, aunque con faltas.  
Esta moneda contiene las siguientes inscripciones escritas en letra *nasji*.  
Anverso  
Centro: se lee la frase “Dios es uno”, pero la palabra “Dios” en árabe, *Ilah*, está mal escrita.  
Anillo interior: “El Padre, el Hijo y el Espíritu Santo”.  
Anillo exterior: “Acuñada en Acre, en el año mil doscientos cincuenta y uno de la encarnación de nuestro Señor”. Esta frase va seguida de una cruz con dos puntos a los lados.  
Reverso  
Centro: en medio del círculo hay una cruz con puntos en diagonal, uno arriba a la izquierda y otro abajo a la derecha.  
Anillo interior: se ve una cruz pequeña con un par de puntos a cada lado. La inscripción dice así: “Nuestra resurrección, nuestra salvación está en Él, protéjanos”.  
Anillo exterior: en el perímetro se aprecia una figura que parece una cruz con un punto a cada lado y la frase “Estamos orgullosos de la cruz de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, en Él está nuestra paz”.  
Cabe mencionar que hay varias palabras mal escritas y que el texto contiene numerosos errores lingüísticos, lo que dificulta su lectura.

Esta moneda de oro, un dinar, fue acuñada por los cruzados en Acre. Para que circulase sin problemas, los cruzados usaron el estilo numismático islámico siguiendo el prototipo local fatimí, con inscripciones árabes dispuestas en tres círculos concéntricos y una cruz central.
keywords: Moneda; dinar; oro; acuñación; Acre; cruzado; rey Luis IX; cruz; numismática

fr.name: Dinar (pièce d'or).
description:
Pièce de monnaie en or datant des Croisés, d'une valeur comparable à celle du dinar. Une fois installés dans la région, les Européens se livrèrent rapidement à un important commerce. Pour que leur monnaie soit reconnue par le marché, ils frappèrent des pièces similaires à celles du pays et inscrivirent les indications de frappe en arabe. Cette pièce reprend un prototype fatimide. Son inscription est composée selon trois cercles concentriques. Elle a été frappée en Acre en 1251 J.-C. (549 H), sous le règne du roi de France Louis IX (1214-1270 J.-C.) qui conduisit les VIIe et VIIIe Croisades. La frappe de ces pièces fut initiée par un nouveau légat papal arrivé au printemps 1250 qui considérait que l'utilisation de monnaies au nom du prophète ou de souverains musulmans était un blasphème. Il en interdit la frappe, qu'il remplaça par des pièces à symboles chrétiens et texte délibérément frappé en langue arabe, souvent erronée.  
Cette pièce présente les inscriptions suivantes en écriture de style *naskhi* :  
Avers  
Centre " : Dieu est un", le terme arabe pour Dieu (Ilah) est incorrect.  
Anneau intérieur : "Le Père, le Fils et le Saint Esprit"  
Anneau extérieur : "Frappé en Acre en l'an mil deux cent cinquante et un, de l'incarnation de notre Seigneur". Cette phrase est suivie d'une croix flanquée de deux points.  
Revers  
Centre : Une croix flanquée de deux points en diagonale.  
Cercle intérieur : Petite croix flanquée d'une paire de points de chaque côté à proximité de la croix centrale. L'inscription dit : "Notre résurrection, notre salut sont en lui, protégez-nous."  
Cercle extérieur : Sur le périmètre, une forme probable de croix entre deux points et la phrase : "Nous sommes fiers de la croix de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, en lui est notre paix."  
Un certain nombre de mots sont mal orthographiés et le texte présente de nombreuses erreurs linguistiques qui rendent sa lecture difficile.

Ce dinar en or a été frappé par les Croisés en Acre. Pour éviter de perturber les activités économiques, les Croisés battirent monnaie dans le style islamique, à partir du prototype fatimide à inscriptions en arabe disposée en trois cercles concentriques auxquels s'ajouta une croix.
keywords: Pièces de monnaie ; dinar ; or ; frappe ; Acre ; croisé ; roi Louis IX ; croix; numismatique

de.name: Neuer Festsaal (Fürstensaal; jetzt Hauskapelle des Klosters)
description: Der idealiter für den Empfang des bayerischen Kurfürsten als Landesherrn konzipierte Festsaal ist im höfischen Régencestil dekoriert. Das zentrale Deckenbild versetzt die Gründung der Abtei in die damalige Gegenwart, um das ambivalente Verhältnis zwischen klösterlicher Herrschaftstreue und herrscherlicher Fürsorge zu bekräftigen.
artist: Stuck und Fresken: Johann Baptist (1680-1758) und Johann Joseph (1707-1743) Zimmermann

en.name: New Festival Hall (Princely Hall; now the convent chapel of the Salesian monastery)
description: The Festival Hall, ideally conceptualised for the reception of Bavarian electoral princes as sovereigns, is decorated in the courtly Régence style. The central ceiling painting illustrates the establishment of the abbey as if it occurred in the present day at the time. This reinforces the ambivalent relationship between monastic allegiance and welfare provided by the sovereign.
place: First floor in the south wing of the arcade court
artist: Stucco and frescoes: Johann Baptist (1680–1758) and Johann Joseph (1707–43) Zimmermann
partner: University of Munich, Institute of Art History

ar.name: تطريز.
description: أرضية هذا القماش المربع مصنوعة من الحرير الأبيض، ولها إطار يحيط بالمنطقة الوسطى المطرزة بأزهار صغيرة مفردة، وفي الزوايا يظهر تصميم من الأزهار الكبيرة المنبثقة من زهرية والحوالق الممتدة على الأطراف، وقد تم تنفيذ الأزهار بالحرير بدرجات الألوان المختلفة.
تطريز على قطعة من القماش الحريري الأبيض. في وسط القطعة المربعة، ثمة أزهار منفردة مطرزة. أما الحافة فعليها أزهار كبيرة منبثقة من مزهرية.
keywords: تطريز؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ نسيج.
materials: تطريز من الحرير موشى بخيوط ذهبية.
tags: تطريز من الحرير موشى بخيوط ذهبية.

en.name: Embroidery.
description: The ground material of this square cloth is made of white silk. A broad border encloses the middle area, which is embroidered with small single flowers. The border shows a corner design of large flowers emerging from a vase and tendrils along the sides. The blossoms and leaves are executed in gradated shades of different-coloured silk.
Embroidery on a ground of white silk. In the middle the square cloth is embroidered with single flowers. The border shows large flowers emerging from a vase.
keywords: Textiles; embroidery; floral decoration

es.name: Bordado
description: Tejido cuadrangular de seda blanca. El área central está enmarcada por un borde con pequeñas flores individuales bordadas; los ángulos están decorados con grandes flores que salen de un jarrón y zarcillos a los lados. Las flores y hojas están ejecutadas en hilo de seda de tonas graduales.
Tejido de seda blanca bordado con flores individuales en el centro y grandes flores saliendo de jarrones en los ángulos del borde.
dates: Alrededor del año 1132-42 de la Hégira/ 1720-30 d.C.
keywords: tejidos; bordados; decoración floral
materials: Bordado con hilos de seda y de oro.
tags: Bordado con hilos de seda y de oro.

fr.name: Broderie
description: La broderie a été réalisée sur un carré de soie blanche. Une large bordure entoure le vaste champ central brodé de petites fleurs. À chaque angle, de grandes fleurs sortent d’un vase, entourées de rameaux végétaux. Les fleurs et les feuilles sont brodées de fils de soie de diverses nuances de couleurs.
Broderie sur soie blanche. Le centre est brodé de fleurs séparées. Les bordures sont ornées de grandes fleurs sortant d’un vase.
keywords: Textiles; broderies; décoration florale.
materials: Broderie de fils de soie et d’or.
tags: Broderie de fils de soie et d’or.

en.name: Bridal outfit (*entari*, long jacket and shoes)
short_description: This *entari* (dress) is made of turquoise satin embroidered in various stitches using silver-gilt thread. The bridal outfit is completed by a matching *hırka* (long jacket) made of the same fabric and lined with red fox fur, and matching heeled shoes with uppers of the same fabric and soles made of leather. The tailored bodice of the *entari* is lengthened by flaps of fabric that fall over the skirt, giving the *entari* the appearance of a two-piece skirt and blouse. The front of the bodice is decorated with frills. The skirt flares out from the waist downwards. The scalloped hem is trimmed with a tiny pleated frill. The jacket has a round neck and fitted sleeves, and opens down the front. The shoes are embroidered in silver and decorated at the toe with a blue-tasselled flower.
holder: Vehbi Koç Foundation Sadberk Hanim Museum
keywords: fashion; traditional dress; textile
partner: Vehbi Koç Foundation Sadberk Hanim Museum

en.name: Pearl Diver’s Finger Protectors
short_description: These finger guards are known as khabt (pl. khabta). They were an essential part of a pearl-diver's equipment, as they protected his finger tips from the sharp oyster shells and other unexpected dangerous objects the pearl-diver might brush his fingers against while searching the murky seabed. Much of his work had to rely on touch, as visibility was minimal and few dangers could be anticipated by sight alone. When not used, the finger guards were kept in a container filled with water to keep them supple.
type: 15 leather finger protectors with cotton bag
holder: Sharjah Maritime Museum / Sharjah Museums Department
dates: Hegira late 13th – early 14th century / AD late 19th – early 20th century
keywords: khabt; khabta

en.name: Photograph of El-Hank Lighthouse, Port of Casablanca
description: A photograph of El-Hank lighthouse and its annexes, located south of Casablanca Port on the headland known as Pointe d’el-Hank. A lighthouse has stood here to guide ships safely into the harbour since the beginning of the 20th century.
holder: National Library of the Kingdom of Morocco
keywords: Technical innovation; communication; port; trade; commerce; economy; strategical port; strategical hub; modernisation; industrialisation; Moroccan ports; traditional port; trading route; port of Casablanca; maritime route
partner: Ministry of Culture, Directorate for Cultural Heritage

en.name: Farmer with Dried Gourd
description:
This type of gourd, grown in Hit, Anbar Governorate, Iraq, is among a number of varieties of calabash or "bottle gourd" of different shapes and sizes that were historically used as multipurpose vessels, including water bottles and containers for agricultural produce including beer and wine, milk and other dairy products, honey or grains. Cut segments of these gourds could also be used to make kitchen utensils such as ladles and bowls. They have been cultivated in Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas for thousands of years for similar purposes.  
  
While the same gourds can be harvested young for consumption as a vegetable, if grown as containers or utensils they are left to grow for longer and harvested when mature. After harvesting, they are dried for several months until the outer shell becomes hard. The dried gourds are usually cut at the top to make an opening through which the seeds are removed and contents added for storage.
holder: Open Museum Initiative for Water Culture
keywords: Water, gourd, calabash, container, vessel, utensil.
tags: Water, gourd, calabash, container, vessel, utensil.
partner: Open Museum Initiative for Water Cultures

ar.name: لوحتان عاجيتان.
description:
قطعتان مستطيلتان متطاولتان من عاج الفيل الشاحب اللون، كانتا متطابقتان بالارتفاع بالأساس قبل كسر إحداهما. اللوحتان مزخرفتان بطريقة الحفر بأشكال تصويرية على أرضية من الأرابيسك أو الزخارف النباتية اللولبية الشكل. يضع الشكل الإنساني الموجود في أعلى اللوحة السليمة قبعة مزخرفة بصليب، ويحمل صليباً بيزنطياً مزدوجاً، وهو على الأغلب كاهن مسيحي، وفي الوسط شكل إنساني يمثل حاكماً مسيحياً يرتدي زرداً يحمل زخرفاً على شكل Y على ثيابه، وتاجاً ثلاثي الرؤوس. يحمل الشكل الإنساني المتبقي صليباً في يده اليمنى، ومبخرة في يده اليسرى من النوع المستخدم في الطقوس المسيحية. فقدت اللوحة المكسورة الشكل العلوي ونصف الشكل الأوسط، ويرتدي الشكل الإنساني في الأسفل عمامة تغطي شعره الطويل ويحمل قارورة ذات عنق طويل. وقد افترض بعض الباحثين أنه موجود في بلاط مسلم، لكنه من الممكن أن يكون مسيحياً لأن كلاً من المسيحيين والمسلمين كانوا يرتدون العمامات. جميع الأشكال الإنسانية ترتدي ثوباً ينسدل حتى أسفل الركبتين مع أحزمة منخفضة وأربطة حول الذراع.  
تحمل القطعة السليمة خمس حفر متوضعة بشكل عشوائي، وهي غير مرئية من الأمام، ويبدو أنها قد حُفرت بهدف تعليق اللوحة بعنصر أكبر، لكن القطعة المكسورة لا تحمل مثل هذه الحفر، ويبدو من المحتمل أنهما كانتا مركبتين على العنصر الأكبر بواسطة المواد اللاصقة، ونظراً لرقة اللوحتين، ولأن الأشكال كلها تبدو متجهة نحو الداخل، فالأغلب أنهما كانتا تشكلان إطاراً حول غلاف كتاب، ومن الممكن أنهما قد صنعتا بناء على طلب حاكم مسيحي كغلاف لإنجيل أو كتاب ديني آخر.

لوحان من العاج، حُفر عليها أشكال وأرابيسك. تبدو الأشكال المحفورة مسيحية: أحدها يحمل شكل صليب بيزنطي، والآخر يحمل شكل مبخرة كانت قد استُخدمت في الطقوس الدينية المسيحية. وهذا يدلّ على أنها صُنعت من قبل فنانين مسلمين، تمّ تعيينهم من قبل شخص مسيحي.
keywords: أرابيسك؛ زخرفة تصويرية؛ زخرفة نباتية لولبية الشكل.

en.name: Two ivory plaques.
description:
Two tall rectangular plaques carved from pale elephant ivory. Originally the same height but one of them has since broken. Both plaques are carved with figures against a ground of arabesques or vegetal scrolls. The figure at the top of the unbroken piece wears a hat decorated with a cross and holds a Byzantine double-barred cross. He is probably a Christian ecclesiastic. In the centre is a figure representing a Christian ruler; he is wearing chain-mail, indicated by the Y-shaped motif on his garment, and a three pointed crown. The remaining figure carries a cross in his right hand and in his left an incense burner of the type used in Christian liturgy. The broken plaque is missing the top figure and half of the central figure. The bottom figure wears a turban over long hair and carries a long-necked bottle. Some scholars have assumed that he is a Muslim court attendant. However, he could be a Christian as turbans were worn by members of both religions. All the figures wear a tunic falling just below the knee with low-slung belts and decorative tiraz bands around the upper arms.  
The intact plaque has five holes irregularly placed that are invisible from the front, which appear to have been drilled to attach it to a larger object. However, the broken plaque has no holes. It is likely then that they were fixed to a larger object with glue. Given the slim shape of the plaques and the fact that the figures all look inwards it seems likely that they once formed the frame around a book cover. They may have been commissioned by a Christian ruler for the cover of a Bible, or another Christian religious text.

Two ivory plaques carved with figures and arabesques. The figures seem to be Christian: one is holding a Byzantine cross and another an incense burner used in Christian liturgy. This suggests that these pieces, although made by a Muslim craftsman, were probably commissioned by a Christian.
keywords: Figurative decoration; vegetal decoration; arabesque; Christian themes

es.name: Dos placas de marfil
description:
Placas rectangulares talladas hechas con colmillo de elefante. Originalmente, ambas tenían la misma altura, aunque de una sólo conservamos un fragmento. Están decoradas con figuras talladas sobre un fondo de arabescos y volutas.  
La figura superior de la placa íntegra representa probablemente a un eclesiástico cristiano: va tocado con un sombrero decorado con una cruz y porta la doble cruz bizantina. La figura central representa a un gobernante cristiano vestido con una cota de malla, a juzgar por la forma en Y, y con una corona de tres puntas. La figura inferior porta una cruz en su mano derecha y, en la izquierda, un quemador de incienso como los que se utilizaban en la liturgia cristiana.  
En la segunda placa faltan la figura superior y la mitad de la figura central de la segunda placa. La figura inferior de esta placa lleva un turbante sobre el cabello largo y porta una botella de cuello alargado. Algunos estudiosos interpretaron esta figura como un asistente de la corte musulmana. Sin embargo, podría ser un cristiano también, pues los miembros de ambas religiones usaban turbante.  
Todas la figuras representadas visten túnicas hasta las rodillas con cinturones en la cadera y mangas decoradas con bandas de *tiraz en las mangas.  
La placa intacta presenta cinco agujeros a distancia irregular uno de otro, invisibles desde la parte frontal, que servían para fijarla a un objeto de mayor tamaño. La segunda placa no presenta dichos agujeros, por lo que podrían fijarse con cola. Dada su forma estrecha y el hecho de que todas las figuras están representadas mirando hacia el interior, puede que formaran el marco de la tapa de un libro; quizás algún gobernante cristiano las encargó para la tapa de una Biblia u otro libro religioso.*

Dos placas de marfil con figuras y arabescos tallados. Las figuras parecen cristianas: una porta la cruz bizantina y otra un quemador de incienso como los utilizados en la liturgia cristiana. Todo lleva a pensar en un encargo para un cliente cristiano, aunque fuera obra de un artesano musulmán.
dates: Siglo VIII de la Hégira / XIV d. C.
keywords: decoración figurativa; caulículos vegetales; arabescos

fr.name: Deux plaques d’ivoire.
description:
Deux étroites plaques rectangulaires en ivoire d'éléphant sculpté. Initialement de la même longueur, l'une d'elles a été brisée. Toutes deux sont décorées de figures sur fond d'arabesques ou de volutes végétales. La figure du haut de la plaque intacte porte une coiffure ornée d'une croix et tient dans sa main une croix byzantine à double croisillon. Il s'agit probablement d'un ecclésiastique chrétien. Au centre se tient un souverain chrétien porteur d'un cote de maille – comme le laisse penser le motif en Y de son vêtement – et d'une couronne à trois fleurons. Le dernier personnage tient une croix dans la main droite et un encensoir du type liturgique chrétien dans la main gauche. La figure du haut et la moitié de la figure centrale de la plaque brisée ont disparu. Celle du bas, coiffée d'un turban sur ses cheveux longs, tient une bouteille à long goulot. Certains chercheurs pensent qu'il s'agit d'un serviteur de cour musulman, mais qui pourrait être tout aussi bien chrétien puisque les turbans étaient portés par les membres des deux religions. Toutes les figures, vêtues d'une tunique descendant juste en dessous du genou, portent leurs ceintures sur les hanches et des bandeaux décoratifs en *tiraz* en partie supérieure des bras.  
La plaque intacte présente cinq trous de disposition irrégulière, invisibles de devant, qui ont sans doute été forés pour la fixer à un objet plus grand. La plaque brisée n'est pas percée. Il est probable que toutes deux ont été collées à un objet de dimensions plus importantes. Étant donné leur minceur et le fait que les figures regardent vers l'intérieur, on peut penser qu'elles constituaient un cadre appliqué sur une couverture de livre. Elles ont pu être commandées par un souverain chrétien pour la reliure d'une bible ou d'un autre texte religieux.

Deux plaques d'ivoire sculpté de figures et d'arabesques. Les personnages semblent chrétiens : l'un porte une croix byzantine et l'autre un encensoir utilisé dans la liturgie chrétienne. Ceci suggère que, bien qu'exécutées par un artisan musulman, ces pièces furent probablement commanditées par un chrétien.
dates: VIIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Décoration figurative ; volutes végétales ; arabesques

en.name: Emir Han
description:
Emir Han, also known as Bey Han, is part of the first royal complex of Bursa, commissioned by Orhan Gazi, composing a mosque, *hammam*, *madrasa*, *mektep*, and *imaret*. When the site was chosen, great attention was paid to the development of the town, and the complex was constructed in an empty area to the east. The area was enlivened by the construction of this complex and even today forms Bursa’s commercial centre.  
Entering the *han* through the simple gate by the northeast minaret of Great Mosque, one arrives on the upper floor; there is another gate on the north opening into the street on the lower level. The *han* consists of rooms, located behind porticoes, and surrounding a courtyard and a small stable downstairs. There are no windows in the 36 lower rooms; in the upper 38 rooms there is a fireplace and a window opening outwards. There is no inscription, but it is believed that it was built in the second half of the 14th century. Emir Han is one of the earliest examples of the Ottoman city *han*s.

es.name: Han del Emir (opción)
description:
El *han* del Emir, también llamado *han* del Bey, forma parte del primer complejo real que hizo construir Orhan Gazi y consta de mezquita, *han*, *madrasa*, *mektep* e *imaret*. Por la ubicación elegida, queda claro que se estaba tratando de hacer crecer la ciudad y que el complejo se levantó en una zona sin edificar de la parte oriental. La construcción del complejo dio vida a la zona, que sigue siendo el centro comercial de Bursa.  
Al entrar por la sencilla puerta que hay junto al alminar noreste de la mezquita Mayor, uno se encuentra directamente en el piso superior; hay otra entrada en el lado norte que se abre a la calle desde la planta baja. El *han* tiene un patio con pórticos, detrás de los cuales están las habitaciones y un pequeño establo. Las 36 habitaciones de la planta inferior no tienen ventana, mientras que las 38 del piso superior tienen hogar y una ventana a la calle. No hay ninguna inscripción que informe de la construcción, pero se cree que pudo levantarse en la segunda mitad del siglo XIV. El *han* del Emir es uno de los primeros ejemplos de *han* urbano otomano.

en.name: Khotan Pomegranate Tree Carpet
description:
A 19th Pomegranate Tree carpet from north-east Central Asia, from Khotan or Yarqand, East Turkistan (today in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China). This silk pile carpet has as dark blue background in its centre-field and a predominantly red border. The centre-field is dominated by a wine-red, ivory and green pomegranate tree that grows out of a small ivory vase at the base of the field. The tree branches out upwards in an abstracted symmetrical layout. Both along the main stem of the tree and on the tips of its horizontal branches are hanging pomegranate fruits that have been depicted with their seeds showing. Small buds and leaves grow on the threes stems and branches. The carpet’s border comprises of three bands of geometric patterns: the outer and inner bands are made up of pink coloured “T”-shaped elements, angled at right angles in association with each other, creating a continuous geometric decorative frame. The centre border-band holds a blue repeat chain of swastikas on a red background.  
  
The depiction of a pomegranate tree growing out of a vase reminds of the ancient tree of life or tree of knowledge that appears on the arts of many ancient civilisations in Asia. Here it is believed to be an invocation of the three-of-life in the Islamic tradition which grows out of the font-of-life in Paradise.  
  
The swastika motif in this carpet is almost as ancient a symbol as the tree of life. In Asian cultures it is seen as an auspicious symbol. On this carpet it has been applied as a decorative motif inherited from the region’s Buddhist heritage.
place: Khotan or Yarqand, East Turkistan (Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China)
keywords: silk; tree of life; fruit; pomegranate; swastika; vase; font of life
materials: Cotton warp and weft, silk pile
tags: Cotton warp and weft, silk pile

en.name: The Pietroasa Treasure
short_description: One of the most valuable gold treasures of Romania is the Pietroasa hoard, which consists of five golden vessels and seven golden pieces of jewelry with a total weight of 19 kg. Dating from the centuries 4-5 AD, the hoard is attributed to the Goths. It was discovered accidentally in April 1837 by two peasants who sold it to an Albanian contractor named Verussi. Knowing that all treasures found in the Romanian soil had to be handed in to the authorities, Verussi tried to hide the hoard and even smashed some of the items to make them smaller. Even though he was eventually caught by the police, from the initial 22 items of the hoard only 12 were recuperated. The Pietroasa treasure was first internationally exhibited in 1867 at the universal exposition in Paris, where it enjoyed a great success.
dates: 4th century AD; discovered in 1837; exhibited in 1867

en.name: Portrait of Sultan Abdülaziz (1830–1876)
short_description: Portrait of the Sultan Abdülaziz. In 1867 the sultan made a trip to Europe. He was invited by Napoleon III to visit the World's Fair Exhibition in Paris. He also visited London and met Emperor Franz Joseph in Vienna.
keywords: Abdülaziz; Paris; World Fair Exhibition; Emperor Franz Joseph

de.name: St. Stephanus-Altar (Hochaltar)
description: Der Hochaltar mit Säulenaufbau, geschwungenem Gebälk und hoch aufragendem, vergoldeten Auszug bildet den prächtigen Zielpunkt der Raumflucht. Mit der Steinigung des Kirchenpatrons Stephanus ist auf dem Altarblatt die entscheidende Szene dargestellt, das erste Martyrium eines Bekenners. Stephanus sieht im Moment seines Todes den Himmel offen. Die Szene ist somit Teil des Bildprogramms, das in den Deckenfresken fortgesetzt wird, veranschaulicht aber auch die hierarchische Funktion des Heiligen als Mittler zwischen Himmel und Erde – wie der Hochaltar auch durch das eucharistische Sakrament vermittelt.

en.name: Altar of St. Stephen (high altar)
description: The high altar with its column superstructure, curved entablature and towering, gilded altar crown, forms the magnificent focal point of the enfilade. The altarpiece depicts the decisive event in the life of the church patron, the stoning of St. Stephen. In the moment of his death St. Stephen sees the heavens open. Thus the scene forms part of the pictorial programme continued in the ceiling frescos, while illustrating the function of the saint as mediator between heaven and earth, analogue to the Eucharist sacrament.

ar.name: جرّة كبيرة.
description:
هذه القطعة من الآثار الفخّارية الغنية بالزخارف، وتدل على تطوّر واضح في صنع الفخار. وهي عبارة عن جرّة ماء كبيرة تعرَف بـ "الخبّ". الجرّة ذات جذع بيضوي وعنق أسطواني وشفة حلقية بارزة، وليس لها قاعدة. معظم الجذع مشغول بصفوف من أشكال متكررة تشبه رأس حيوان ذي قرنين. أما العنق فهو مشغول بأشكال آدمية وخيالية مضافة وملصوقة على سطح منقوش بزخارف نباتية. يفصل بين الجذع والعنق نطاق كتابي بخط الثلث، يمكن قراءة نصه على النحو التالي: "عز وإقبال وسلامة وسعادة وكرامة وغبطة ورفعة."  
  
يمكن وصف أحد مشاهد زخارف العنق كالتالي: يوجد في منتصف المنظر شخص جالس في وضعية مواجهة، ويبدو في وضعية تعبّد شرقية (أي ذراعاه مثنيتان عند الكوع وكفّاه مفتوحتان). يحيط به من فوق رأسه قوس بتنينين متقابلين لهما فاهان فاغران وأنياب بارزة. وتحت مخالب التنينين هناك عقدة بارزة وعلى جانبيها وجوه سبع لها عيون وفتحات أنف وآذان مجوفة مستديرة. هذه الأشكال الخيالية تتواصل في الأسفل أيضاً حيث أن الشخص يقعد على رأسي طائرين متقابلين لكل منهما رأس فتاة ذات شعر مصفف وأجنحة مزخرفة بأناقة. وتحت كلا هذين الطائرين وجوه أسود أو سباع. جميع هذه الأشكال موضوعة على شبك من زخارف نباتية محوّرة ومخرّمة.
جرة كبيرة، ذات شكل بيضاوي، تظهر فيها نقوش وزخارف لأشكال مختلفة، صنعت هذه القطعة في الجزيرة العربية، في القرنين الخامس والسادس الهجريين/ الحادي عشر والثاني عشر الميلاديين.
place: منطقة الجزيرة بين نهر الفرات والخابور.
keywords: جرّة؛ الجزيرة؛ خط الثلث؛ العصر الأتابكي؛ فخّار.

en.name: Large jar.
description:
A large, unglazed but richly decorated *khubb* jar used for storing water. It has an oval-shaped body without a base. Most of the body's surface is decorated with a repeating pattern resembling a stylised horned animal head. The cylindrical neck and protruding lip are richly decorated with pierced carving and applied pieces of clay that were attached to the body of the jar after its basic shape was made. These include human forms in profile and in a standing posture amidst allegorical creatures and stylised foliage. A band of Arabic writing in *thuluth* script divides the ovoid shape of the jar between body and neck. It is possible to translate the text as follows: “\[May God grant\] power, prosperity, happiness, respect, bliss and advancement.”  
One of the decorative scenes applied on the jar's neck may be described as follows: in the centre is a frontally oriented person who is sitting in the "Eastern" posture of worship (i.e. with his arms bent up at the elbow and palms facing the object of worship). He is framed by an overhead arch with a pair of open-jawed dragons facing each other. Beneath the dragons' claws there is a protruding knob flanked by a pair of lion-like faces whose eyes, nostrils, and ears are accentuated by pierced circles. Similar fantastical imagery continues below the seated figure. His crossed legs rest on top of two human-headed birds with young female faces, coiffed hair and elegantly decorated wings. Beneath these fantastical birds there is a pair of protruding lion heads. All these figures are placed on a background of stylised, perforated vegetal motifs.
This large water-jar with its ovoid shape, pierced carving and moulded figurative attachments is a masterpiece of the pottery industry of Jazira in the AH 5th and 6th / AD 11th and 12th centuries.
place: Jazira (the region located between the Euphrates and Tigris rivers, hence known as “the island” and currently consisting of northeast modern Syria and northwest Iraq), or Mesopotamia.
keywords: Jar; earthenware; pottery; ceramics; Jazira; thuluth

es.name: Gran tinaja.
description:
Gran tinaja o *jubb* para agua, sin vidriar, de refinada decoración, cuerpo ovalado y sin base. La mayor parte de la superficie del cuerpo está decorada con un motivo repetido, parecido a una estilizada cabeza de animal astado. El cuello cilíndrico, terminado en un borde sobresaliente, presenta una elaborada decoración calada, así como piezas de arcilla que se agregaron al cuerpo de la tinaja una vez fabricada la forma básica y que representan figuras humanas en pie y de perfil entre seres alegóricos y motivos vegetales estilizados. El cuerpo y el cuello de la tinaja quedan separados por una banda horizontal de caligrafía *zuluz* con este texto: “\[Que Dios conceda\] poder, prosperidad, felicidad, respeto, dicha y progreso”.  
Una de las escenas decorativas del cuello de la tinaja podría describirse así: en el centro se ve a una persona de frente, sentada en la postura “oriental” de adoración (es decir, con los brazos doblados y las palmas orientadas hacia el objeto de culto). Está enmarcada por un arco con dos dragones afrontados y con las fauces abiertas. Debajo de las garras de los dragones se aprecia un bulto flanqueado por dos caras de león con los ojos, las narices y las orejas perforados. Bajo la figura sentada se ven otras imágenes fantásticas. Las piernas cruzadas de la figura humana descansan sobre dos aves con cabeza de mujer joven, con el cabello peinado y las alas elegantemente decoradas. Debajo de estas aves fantásticas sobresalen dos cabezas de león. Todas estas figuras aparecen sobre un fondo de estilizados motivos vegetales calados.
Esta gran tinaja para agua de forma ovoide, con talla calada y complementos figurativos moldeados, es una obra maestra de la alfarería de al-Yazira de los siglos V-VI / XI-XII.
dates: Siglo VI de la Hégira / XII d. C.
place: Al-Yazira (región ubicada entre los ríos Éufrates y Tigris, por lo que se la conoce como “la isla”; actualmente comprende el noreste de Siria y el noroeste de Irak) o Mesopotamia.
keywords: Tinaja; barro cocido; cerámica; alfarería; al-Yazira; escritura zuluz.

fr.name: Grande jarre.
description:
Grande jarre *khubb* en terre cuite non vernie mais richement décorée, utilisée pour la conservation de l'eau. Elle possède un corps ovale sans pied.
