en.name: Crucifixion
description: This Crucifixion with the deposition from the cross and the fading Madonna on the lower right is clearly the work of Lucio Massari (1569–1633). This painter has been considered for a long time a mediocre artist. Today we tend to appreciate his luminous palette and the style, reminiscent of Annibale Carracci. After the restorations of 2000 the soldiers playing dice on Jesus’ clothes became visible again.
place: Oratory of the Madonna dell’Orazione, entrance wall
partner: Musei Civici d’Arte Antica di Bologna in cooperation with the Province of Bologna

it.name: Crocefissione
description: Questa Crocefissione con la *Deposizione dalla croce* e lo *Svenimento della Vergine* in basso a destra è chiaramente opera di Lucio Massari (1569–1633). Di questo pittore, per lungo tempo considerato autore di secondo piano, oggi si tende ad apprezzare la luminosa tavolozza e lo stile che ricorda quello di Annibale Carracci. Dopo I restauri del 2000 è possibile apprezzare di nuovo le figure dei soldati che estraggono a dadi le vesti di Cristo.
place: Oratorio della Madonna dela Consolazione, parete d'ingresso

en.name: Flag of the St Petersburg Colony of Macedonians
short_description: This flag was the symbol of the St. Petersburg Colony of Macedonians, a group of Macedonian intellectuals who lived and worked in St. Petersburg and shared the same ideas and interests – working for the liberation and recognition of Macedonia. The red colour of the flag symbolizes the blood shed in the centuries-long Macedonian struggle for autonomy. The white rectangle in the upper left corner bears a depiction of a unicorn, also in red colour.
keywords: Autonomy; liberation; recognition

ar.name: حوض.
description:
قطعة رائعة من القطع المعدنية المملوكية على شكل حوض كبير ذي حافة تتجه نحو الخارج، وهو مطعم من الداخل والخارج بزخارف من الفضة والذهب. يحيط بالجزء المركزي من الحوض نقش مدهش بالخط الثلث، يظهر عليه اسم السلطان المملوكي الناصر محمد بن قلاوون وألقابه، وقد حكم في الفترة 692 و743/ 1293 و1341. يعتبر هذا الحوض واحداً من الأواني المعدنية العائدة لهذه الفترة والتي تحمل كتابات كعناصر زخرفية رئيسة. لقد تم وضع النقش الأساس على خلفية من الأرابيسك الذي تتحول أطرافه إلى أشكال بط أو طيور، ويقسمه ثلاث رصائع مليئة بأزهار اللوتس، وفي مركزها شعار كتابي صغير يحمل عبارة "عز لمولانا السلطان". يحيط بهذا الشريط المركزي من الأعلى إفريزان من الزخارف الزهرية بالتناوب مع ست حليات دائرية تحوي نقوشاً إضافية.  
اشتقت أزهار اللوتس والفاوانيا من النماذج الصينية التي أحضرها المغول إلى إيران، ويمكن العثور على هذه النماذج الزهرية في الفن الإيراني العائد إلى الفترة نفسها. ويرى في النقش حول الحافة من الداخل عبارة "عز لمولانا السلطان الملك الناصر العالم العامل الغازي، المجاهد المرابط ناصر الدنيا والدين محمد بن قلاوون عز نصره". لقد تم استخدام الأحواض الكبيرة كهذا الحوض لأغراض تشريفية عديدة، لكن السمكة المحيطة في الأسفل يمكن أن تدل على أنه كان يستخدم كحوض للوضوء.

حوض كبير الحجم نسبياً، مصنوع من النحاس المطلي بالفضة، والمُطعَّم بالذهب, والذي استُخدم للوضوء. يمتدُّ على محيط الحوض نقش ظاهر، كُتب فيه اسم ومعلومات عن السلطان المملوكي الناصر الدين محمد بن قلاوون (حكم ما بين عامي 692-743 هـ/ 1293- 1341 م).
keywords: زخرفة زهرية؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ ماء.

en.name: Basin.
description:
A spectacular piece of Mamluk metalwork in the form of a large basin with a flared rim, covered inside and out with silver and gold inlay decoration. A striking *thuluth* inscription surrounds the central panel of the bowl giving the name and titles of the Mamluk Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun, who ruled between AH 692 and 743 / AD 1293 and 1341. This basin is one of a number of metalwork vessels from this period featuring bold inscriptions as the main decorative element. The principal inscription is set against arabesques whose tendrils transform into ducks or birds. Dividing the inscription are three medallions filled with lotus flowers, and a small epigraphic blazon in the centre that reads: ‘Glory to our master, the sultan’. Above and below this central panel are two friezes of floral scrolls alternating with six roundels containing further inscriptions.  
The presence of lotus blossoms and peonies derives from chinoiserie designs, imported by the Mongols in Iran; these floral designs are also found in Iranian art at this time. The inscription around the rim of the interior reads: ‘Glory to our master, the Sultan al-Malik al-Nasir the wise, the efficient, the warrior, the champion of the faith, the defender Nasir al-Dunya wa’l-Din Muhammad ibn Qalawun, may his victory be glorious’. Large basins such as this one were used for a number of ceremonial functions. However, the circling fish in the base suggest that this basin was used as an ablution vessel.

A large brass basin covered in silver and gold inlay, probably used as a vessel for ritual ablutions. A bold inscription band around the body of the basin is the main decorative feature, and displays the name and titles of the Mamluk Sultan al-Nasir al-Din Muhammad ibn Qalawun (AH 692–743 / AD 1293–1341).
keywords: Calligraphy; floral decoration; water; arabesque; Chinese influence
materials: Brass inlaid with silver and gold.
tags: Brass inlaid with silver and gold.

es.name: Jofaina
description:
Espectacular jofaina de metal del periodo mameluco con borde exvasado, bañada en plata y decorada con incrustaciones de plata y oro. Destaca la inscripción en letra *zuluz* que ocupa la banda central; en ella se leen el nombre y los títulos del sultán mameluco al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun, que gobernó en los años 692-743 / 1293-1341. Esta jofaina es uno de los numerosos recipientes de metal del periodo con inscripciones imponentes como motivo decorativo principal. La inscripción se superpone a un fondo de arabescos cuyas terminaciones dibujan patos o pájaros. En la inscripción se intercalan tres medallones con flores de loto y un pequeño blasón epigráfico en el centro que dice: “Gloria a nuestro maestro el sultán”. Por encima y por debajo de la banda central corren dos frisos de roleos florales alternados con seis círculos que contienen más inscripciones.  
Las flores de loto y las peonías se tomaron de objetos chinos importados por los mongoles de Irán; de hecho, encontramos este tipo de diseños florales en el arte iraní de la misma época. La inscripción que recorre la parte interior del borde dice: “Gloria a nuestro maestro el sultán al-Malik al-Nasir, el sabio, el eficiente, el guerrero, el paladín de la fe, el defensor de Nasir al-Dunya wa’l-Din Muhammad ibn Qalawun, que su victoria sea gloriosa”.  
Este tipo de jofainas de gran tamaño tenían funciones ceremoniales. No obstante, el pez enroscado de la base hace pensar que esta jofaina se utilizaba para las abluciones.

Gran jofaina de bronce bañada en plata y con incrustaciones de oro que probablemente se utilizó para abluciones rituales. El principal motivo decorativo es la impresionante inscripción que rodea el cuerpo, en la que se menciona al sultán mameluco al-Nasir al-Din Muhammad ibn Qalawun (r. 692–743  / 1293–1341).
keywords: caligrafía; decoración floral; agua
materials: Bronce con incrustaciones de plata y oro.
tags: Bronce con incrustaciones de plata y oro.

fr.name: Bassin.
description:
Spectaculaire exemple de travail du métal mamelouk, ce grand bassin à bord évasé est tapissé à l'intérieur comme à l'extérieur d'un décor d'incrustations en or et argent. Une très importante inscription en style *thoulouth* cercle la paroi et donne le nom et les titres du sultan mamelouk Nasir al-Din Muhammad (al-Nasir Nasir al-Din Muhammad, fils de Qalawun), qui régna à différentes périodes entre 692 et 743 H / 1293-1341 J.-C. Ce bassin fait partie d'un certain nombre de récipients métalliques qui font d'une épigraphie audacieuse leur principal élément décoratif. L'inscription principale se détache sur un fond d'arabesques dont les vrilles se transforment en canard et autres oiseaux. Trois médaillons interromprent l'inscription. Ils sont ornés de fleurs de lotus et comportent, au centre, un petit blason épigraphique proclamant : “Gloire à notre maître le sultan.” Au-dessus et au-dessous de cet élément central courent deux frises d'enroulements floraux alternant avec six rondeaux contenant d'autres inscriptions.  
La présence de fleurs de lotus et de pivoines vient de motifs chinois importés des Mongols d'Iran, qui s'observent d'ailleurs également dans l'art iranien de cette époque. L'inscription autour du bord, côté intérieur, dit : “Gloire à notre maître, le sultan al-Malik al-Nasir le sage, l'efficace, le combattant, le champion de la foi, le défenseur Nasir al-Dunya wa'l-Din Muhammad ibn Qalawun, que sa victoire lui apporte la gloire.” Ces grands bassins servaient à un certain nombre de fonctions cérémonielles. Néanmoins, le poisson en cercle à sa base suggère qu'il a pu être utilisé pour les ablutions.

Grand bassin de cuivre jaune couvert d'incrustations d'or et d'argent, sans doute utilisé pour les ablutions rituelles. Une épaisse bande d'inscriptions autour du corps du bassin constitue le principal ornement, et livre le nom et les titres du sultan mamelouk al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun (r. 692-741 H / 1293-1341 J.-C.).
keywords: calligraphie ; décoration florale ; eau
materials: Cuivre jaune à incrustations d’or et d’argent.
tags: Cuivre jaune à incrustations d’or et d’argent.

en.name: Mãe d’ Água das Amoreiras reservoir
description: Mãe d' Água das Amoreiras reservoir was designed by Carlos Mardel. Due to its monumentality, the Mãe d'Água constitutes a true civic temple to the *águas livres* (free waters). An antechamber precedes the vast rectangle which contains a deep reservoir.
partner: Institute for the Administration of Architectural and Archaeological Heritage -  IGESPAR

pt.name: “Mãe de Água” das Amoreiras
description: A Mãe de Água das Amoreiras foi projectada por Carlos Mardel. A sua monumentalidade é tão grande que se pode dizer que constitui um verdadeiro templo cívico às “águas livres”. Uma antecâmara precede um vasto rectângulo que abriga um depósito profundo. A grande discrição formal, conjugada com uma sábia gestão dos volumes, confere uma monumentalidade inédita a uma obra de fundo utilitário.

ar.name: بلاطة ذات بغباغاوات خضراوات
description: يتضمن مزيج الألوان لهذه البلاطة الجميلة اللون الأخضر الزمردي وأحمر الطماطم الفاتح المنفذة بحرفية من قبل صانعي الفخار في إزنيق التركية في النصف الثاني من القرن السادس عشر الميلادي والتشكيل المعقد لطائري بغبغاء (أو طاوسيين) على كلا طرفي الحوض محاط بطبقة كثيفة من أوراق الساز saz المسننة الملفوفة التي تمثل الطراز المستحدث في تزيين إزنيق من قبل شاهكولو وهو رئيس معرض التصميم الفني للبلاط في الفترة 1526-56 والصورة المعروفة منذ القدم في الشرق الأوسط لطائرين يرفان بجناحيهما على بركة ماء يشير إلى فكرة الجنة والخلود للروح البشرية. وفي القرن السادس عشر– السابع عشر استخدم العثمانيون بشكل واسع بلاطات الخزف المرسومة للتزيين الداخلي للأبنية الدينية أو الدنيوية وكانت الفكرة تدهش الزائر للمسجد أو القصر بواسطة التباين الحاد بين الجدران الخارجية  البسيطة والجمال الآخاذ للداخل.

en.name: Tile with green parrots
description:
The colour palette of this beautiful tile includes emerald green and bright tomato red that were mastered by potters of Turkish Iznik in the second half of the AD 16th century. The sophisticated composition of two parrots (or peacocks) sitting on either side of the fountain surrounded by a dense foliage of scrolled serrated "*saz*" leaves represent the style introduced into Iznik décor by Şahkulu, the head of the court design atelier from 1526–56. The old-known Middle Eastern motif of two birds flanking a water pool refers to the idea of Paradise and immortality of a human soul.  
In the 16th–17th century the Ottomans widely used painted ceramic tiles for inside decoration of religious or secular buildings. The idea was to strike a visitor of a mosque or palace by a sharp contrast between the austere external walls and the stunning beauty of the interior.
keywords: Ceramics; tile; stonepaste; Turkey; Iznik; Ottoman
materials: Stonepaste; polychrome painted under transparent glaze
partner: The Bohdan and Varvara Khanenko National Museum of Arts

cs.name: Apoteóza sv. Jana Sarkandera
description:
Moravský mučedník je uctíván majiteli panství z Kufsteinu. Dokončení mostu bylo je jedním z jejich stavebních podniků, jimiž “chtějí díky Nejvyššímu projeviti a jeho jméno vždy a všude oslavovati”. Obraz pochází z bočního oltáře kaple  
sv. Anny ve špitále (1743–1745), zřízeném jako domov pro přestárlé sloužící a poddané náměšťského panství. Současně byla postavena i fara, na jejíž výzdobě se podíleli sochař J. Winterhalder st. a malíř K. J. Aigen. K zařízení přilehlého kostela přispěl také P. Troger. Ten patrně zprostředkoval svého přítele Winterhaldera hraběti, pro kterého r. 1737 vymaloval hrobku v Röhrenbachu.

en.name: Apotheosis of St. John Sarkander
description: St. John Sarkander Moravian was a martyr worshipped by the demesne owners, the Kuefstein family. The bridge was a project that would “express their thanks to the Almighty and to celebrate His name always and everywhere”. The picture comes from the side altar in the Chapel of St. Anne, in an infirmary (1743–1745) established as a home for the elderly servants and subjects of the Námešť demesne. A parsonage constructed in parallel was decorated by J. Winterhalder Sr. and K. J. Aigen. The artist P. Troger took part in the decoration of the adjacent church. He was probably introduced to the count – that he had painted a tomb in Röhrenbach for in 1737 – by his friend Winterhalder.
place: Náměšť nad Oslavou, St. Anne Chapel

en.name: Barbadinhos Steam pumping station
short_description: This Lisbon Water Museum is the urban memory symbol of innovation and improvements in public health issues. The Barbadinhos Steam Pumping Station opened on 3 October 1880. It was built to raise the water coming from the Alviela Canal to the Veronica and Cisterna do Monte reservoirs. It was used to increase the volume of the water supplied to the city of Lisbon. The main equipment consists of four steam machines that worked uninterruptedly until 1928. They were built in the workshops of “Constructeurs - Mecaniciens” E. W. Windsor & Fils, of Rouen, France, an English owned company. The machines, whose steam was produced by five boilers, are all of the same kind: vertical pistons with two cylinders each and steam liner – Woolf system – of variable expansion and condensation.
holder: EPAL- Portuguese Society for Water Supply
artist: Windsor House & Fils and Workshops of CAL – Companhia das Águas de Lisboa (Water Company of Lisbon)
history: Classified as CIP – Setting of Public Interest through Decree. º 1176/2010, DR, 2nd Series, no. 248 of 14/12/2010, the Station of Barbadinhos was designed to raise water from the Alviela river to the reservoir of Veronica and to the Cistern of Monte. Opened on 3 October 1880, the station considerably increased the volume of water supplied to the city of Lisbon. Its main equipment, consisting of four steam engines built in the workshops of E. W. Windsor of Rouen, ran until 1928.
keywords: Lisbon water supply; Steam Machinery; Water Museum; Barbadinhos; industrial archaeology building

en.name: Ratkaj Palace
description: Inside the two-winged, two-storey palace, the lower, two-winged ground-floor buildings enclose the inner courtyard. The oldest part of the palace is the rear wing, constructed in the 16th century as a fortified grange. Renaissance features are still extant, manifested in the shape of the courtyard passage, which opens up on both floors with arcades; a similar model was repeated for the side-wing extension in the 17th century. The facade of the two-wing palace was painted with what at the time was a characteristic dark-grey graphite colour with white and yellow accents along the apertures, pillars and arcades and, as an expression of an increasingly high standard of living at the beginning of the 18th century, along the external façade of the side-wing. The addition of annexes for the sanitary facilities improves the architectural projection, articulated with dynamic stucco decorations. The last important architectural development was the addition of a ground-floor wing at the front. Opened up with a grand, central portal surmounted by a small turret, in a formal sense it marked the achievement of the Baroque aspiration for emphasising the central axis and the formation of deep spatial effects.

The Ratkaj complex in Miljana is one of the best preserved examples of a Baroque palace in northwest Croatia. It is a historically stratified complex, composed of a two-winged, two-storey building that closes-off a courtyard. The Baroque fondness for the scenic manifests in the disposition of the higher residential wings with porticoes, which open up with arcades and lower floor utility buildings accented with a tower. The main value of the palace consists in the Early Baroque paintings on the façade and the Rococo frescoes of the interior.
artist: Architect unknown; painter: Anton Joseph (Jožef) Lerchinger (Lerhinger) (c. 1720–after 1787)
history: The palace, of which the first building phase dates from the 16th and 17th centuries, was owned by the noble Ratkaj family until the end of the 18th century (1793), during which time the owners undertook several important reconstructions and enlargements of the complex and through which the current spatial organisation took shape.
keywords: Miljana, Ratkaj Palace, Baroque, two-wing ground plan, multi-coloured façade
tags: Miljana, Ratkaj Palace, Baroque, two-wing ground plan, multi-coloured façade

ar.name: صندوق للغداء.
description: ثلاث حاويات مستديرة من النحاس الأصفر متساوية في الحجم، يمكن أن تتراكب الواحدة فوق الأخرى، لها غطاء، وقد زالت طبقة القصدير في الوقت الحالي. ولا بد أنه كان للصندوق في الأصل حوامل معدنية على الجانبين لربط الأجزاء معاً. يظهر على حافة كل حاوية إطارات زخرفية متطاولة تحتوي على كتابات أو زخارف هندسية، وهي تتناوب مع حليات دائرية تحتوي على تشكيل هندسي مؤلف من تكرار لشكل Y، وقد تم نقش بيت شعر من قصيدة كان من المألوف استعماله على القطع المعدنية العائدة لهذه الفترة ضمن الإطارات الزخرفية، وهو "من تملَّى في جمالي متعة العين يراني. فكمال الحسن يكسوني وأثواب المعاني". يبدو أنه كان يتم وضع نوع طعام مختلف في كل حاوية، وكان الغطاء يستعمل كزبدية، ومن المثير للاهتمام أنه حتى هذه القطعة المتواضعة قد تم نقشها بشكل جميل.

صندوق لحفظ الطعام، مُكوَّن من ثلاثة أوعية مصنوعة من النحاس، تُوضع فوق بعضها البعض، ولها غطاء يمكن أن يستخدم أيضاً كوعاء. استُخدمت هذه القطعة لنقل الطعام، حيث أنه بالإمكان وضع مواد غذائية مختلفة في كل وعاء.
keywords: أداة للاستعمال اليومي؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ طعام.
materials: نحاس أصفر محفور، كان في الأساس مغطى بالقصدير.
tags: نحاس أصفر محفور، كان في الأساس مغطى بالقصدير.

en.name: Lunch box.
description: Three circular brass containers of identical size that stack on top of one another, topped with a lid; the tin layer now worn off. Originally, there would have been metal shafts on each side to hold the parts together. Cartouches around the edge of each container bear inscriptions or geometric patterns. These oblong cartouches alternate with roundels containing a geometric arrangement of repeated Y-shaped motifs. A line from a poem that was popular on metalwork objects of this period is quoted in the inscription cartouches: 'I have a shape which is full of beauty and meaning. Whoever concentrates on my beauty will find me a pleasure for the eye'. Each of the containers would have held a different food, and the lid would have served as a bowl. It is interesting that even such a humble object is beautifully engraved.

A container made of three circular brass bowls stacked on top of each other and topped with a lid. This object was used to transport food; each container would have held a different food with the lid serving as a bowl.
keywords: Food; calligraphy; inscription; poetry; geometric decoration; furnishing; domestic vessels

es.name: Fiambrera
description:
Esta fiambrera consta de tres recipientes circulares de bronce de idéntico tamaño, superpuestos y con una tapa en la parte superior. Originalmente, estaban bañados en estaño y unidos por dos varillas metálicas verticales. Las piezas circulares están decoradas con cartuchos romboidales con inscripciones o diseños geométricos y se alternan con círculos de composiciones geométricas que repiten motivos en forma de Y. En las inscripciones se repite el mismo fragmento de un poema habitual en la metalistería de este periodo: “Tengo una forma que está plena de belleza y el sentido. Aquel que se concentre en mi belleza encontrará en mí un placer para sus ojos”.  
En cada uno de los recipientes se guardaría un tipo de comida y la tapa serviría de cuenco. Resulta interesante que incluso un objeto tan humilde estuviera hermosamente labrado.
Fiambrera formada por tres recipientes circulares superpuestos y con una tapa en la parte superior. Cada recipiente llevaría un tipo de comida y la tapa serviría de cuenco.
dates: Siglo IX de la Hégira  / XV d. C.
keywords: comida; objetos funcionales; caligrafía; decoración geométrica
materials: Bronce grabado y originalmente bañado en estaño.
tags: Bronce grabado y originalmente bañado en estaño.

fr.name: Porte-dîner.
description: Trois récipients ronds en cuivre de taille identique, empilés les uns sur les autres, surmontés d'un couvercle. L'étamage est aujourd'hui très usé. À l'origine, des tiges de métal latérales devaient maintenir ensemble les différentes parties. Les cartouches allongés en bordure de chaque récipient portent des inscriptions ou des motifs géométriques alternant avec des rondeaux à motif géométrique d'éléments en forme de Y répétés. Un vers de poésie populaire sur les objets en métal de cette période est cité dans les cartouches épigraphiques : “Ma forme est pleine de beauté et de sens. Qui se concentre sur ma beauté trouvera en moi le plaisir des yeux.” Chacun des récipients pouvait contenir un aliment différent et le couvercle faisait office de bol. Il est intéressant de noter qu'un objet aussi humble ait pu être aussi superbement gravé.

Porte-dîner fait de trois bols circulaires en cuivre jaune empilés les uns sur les autres et surmontés d'un couvercle. Cet objet servait à transporter de la nourriture ; chaque récipient devait contenir un plat différent et le couvercle servait de bol.
dates: IXe siècle de l’Hégire (XVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: nourriture ; objets utilitaires ; calligraphie ; décoration géométrique
materials: Cuivre jaune gravé, étamé à l’origine.
tags: Cuivre jaune gravé, étamé à l’origine.

en.name: *Ancient Istanbul Houses*
short_description: Hoca Ali Rıza is known as the first painter who used landscapes in Turkish painting. A study of the artist’s works also readily reveals architectural structures which have changed since his time. Such structures included mosques, fountains, dervish monasteries and lodges, tombs, *sebils* (public fountains installed by charities), ruins, cemeteries, bridges, stately homes new and old, towers, old houses and other subjects which architecturally and historically speaking might have been considered ordinary in his day, but which he pursued with a passion. Riza is completely realistic in his works and he specialized in depicting landscapes using light and shadow.
holder: Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University, Painting and Sculpture Museum
keywords: Painting; Hoca Ali Rıza; orientalist Turkish painters
partner: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (General Directorate for Cultural Heritage and Museums)

en.name: Water flask
description: A wooden oval flask with metal edges decorated with zigzag (sawtooth) and wavy branch motifs. The body is ornamented with domed studs and rosettes of multi-petaled flowers with zigzag borders and simple cross-hatched lozenges. Metal fittings include rings for suspension. It features two cylindrical necks (one small, one large, pierced), with covers. One attached by a chain, the other missing.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum FBQ Museum
keywords: Water; flask; wood
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

en.name: *Judith and Holofernes*
description:
This carved panel depicting *Judith and Holofernes* in high relief is part of pair, the other panel is an image of *Rebecca and Eliezer at the Well*.  
During the Baroque era, Northern Europe experienced a revival of collecting precious ivory objects. The anonymous artist is very skilled in ivory carving technique and shows a deep knowledge of Italian classicism and baroque sculpture. The scene is well planned showing Judith with the sword in her hand, the beheaded body of Holofernes and an old servant holding the head of Holofernes. An angel is in the background holding a curtain. Clarity, narrative, theatricality and elegance join together to form a high quality work of art. These two bas-relieves have been frequently attributed to the French sculptor Pierre Puget; if this is correct, these panels are the only surviving ivory works of his.

This carved panel depicting *Judith and Holofernes* in high relief is part of a pair, its pendant showing *Rebecca and Eliezer at the Well*.  
In the seventeenth-century there was a revival in collecting precious carved ivory objects, especially in northern Europe. Clear and efficacious narrative, theatricality and elegance combine in this high quality piece which has all the main features of late seventeenth-century art.
dates: Third quarter of the seventeenth century
Second half of the seventeenth century
keywords: *Judith and Holofernes*; carving; ivory; Pierre Puget; Pendant; university; bas-relief; Christian themes; collection; collector

it.name: *Giuditta e Oloferne*
description:
Il pannello scolpito ad altorilievo con *Giuditta e Oloferne* fa coppia con l'altra scena biblica raffigurante *Rebecca e Eleazaro al pozzo*.  
Il gusto collezionistico per questi preziosi oggetti in avorio rinasce nel XVII secolo soprattutto nel nord Europa. L'anonimo artista, oltre a padroneggiare mirabilmente questa tecnica, mostra di conoscere bene la scultura italiana tra classicismo e barocco. La scena compressa nel piccolo spazio è sapientemente articolata nei passaggi dall'imminente primo piano, occupato dal corpo riverso  decapitato di Oloferne, da Giuditta che impugna la spada e dalla fantesca che tiene nel grembo la testa mozzata, al fondo, dove un angelo emergente trattiene un tendaggio. Chiarezza ed efficacia narrativa, teatralità ed eleganza si compongono in un brano di alta qualità che raccoglie le principali istanze dell'arte del Seicento maturo. Per questo i due altorilievi sono stati messi in relazione con la produzione dello scultore francese Pierre Puget; tuttavia non si conoscono opere in avorio di questo artista.

Il pannello scolpito ad altorilievo con *Giuditta e Oloferne* fa coppia con l'altra scena biblica raffigurante *Rebecca e Eleazaro al pozzo*.  
Il gusto collezionistico per questi preziosi oggetti in avorio rinasce nel XVII secolo soprattutto nel nord Europa. Chiarezza ed efficacia narrativa, teatralità ed eleganza si compongono in un brano di alta qualità in cui si fondono le principali componenti dell'arte del Seicento maturo.

en.name: Central Hotel
short_description: A white Mediterranean-style building with three floors plus the ground floor, the facade has an open feel due to the blue-painted, geometrically ornamented wrought iron balconies, which echo designs seen in lacework and headbands. Located on Place Ahmad el Bidaoui (formerly Place Admiral Philibert), on the port side of the *Medina*, near the customs premises, the hotel played an important historical role in accommodating both tourists and officials.
history: The style of the building refers to contemporary architecture seen in European Mediterranean cities at the time.

en.name: *The Gourmet*
description:
Jacob van Schuppen studied painting with his father – Pierre Louis van Schuppen a painter and engraver in Antwerp – and his uncle, Nicolas Largillière, one of the period's most respected portrait painters. This beginning determined both his career and his preferred genre. Van Schuppen worked both in Paris and at the Lorraine princely court in Luneville as a portrait painter. In 1705, he became a member of the Paris Academy, arriving in Vienna in 1716 as a successful and notable portraitist in the service of Prince Eugene of Savoy. Having been settled in the imperial city for only a short time, he became court painter in 1723. In 1725, he approached the emperor with a plan for a French-style art academy, which he directed from 1726. Vienna's Imperial and Royal Court Academy of Painters, Sculptors and Architecture (Academy of Fine Arts Vienna) was unprecedented in Central Europe and remained the most important institution of its kind in the German-speaking territories. As a painter, van Schuppen was primarily an excellent portraitist. His large-size portraits, representing the aristocracy and contemporary writers and artists, effectively reflect the personality and character of the sitters.  
*The Gourmet*, although for a long time registered as a work of a German master, is an excellent example of van Schuppen's art, holding the characteristic features of his work. Like his other paintings, the motifs of both genre painting and still life are present.  
The objective approach of Dutch and Flemish art, fine colouring and French elegance come together in this painting; the basic motif – a man uplifting his glass to demonstrate his aspirations in seeking happiness in drinking and smoking: the minor pleasures of life – is a favourite and frequent characteristic of 17th-century painters. Although known primarily as a portraitist, van Schuppen nevertheless approached genre painting in a similar way, as can be seen in this painting and others in Hungarian collections.

Jacob van Schuppen, from the Netherlands, was a pupil of his uncle Nicolas Largilliere. From 1716 he lived in Vienna, and from 1726 directed the Academy of Fine Arts in Vienna, breathing new life into the institution, which was renamed the Imperial and Royal Court Academy of Painters, Sculptors and Architecture. *The Gourmet*, showing a man enjoying the finer things of life, is both a portrait and a genre painting.
keywords: Genre painting; allegory; senses; still life; Jacob van Schuppen; Vienna’s Imperial and Royal Court Academy of Painters
tags: Vienna’s Imperial and Royal Court Academy of Painters

ar.name: مصحف
description: هذا المصحف الرائع مصنوع لأجل سوكولو محمد باشا والذي عمل كوزير أكبر لسلطانين عثمانيين ، سليمان الأول ( الكبير ، الذي حكم خلال 1520-66 ) وخلفه سليم الثاني (حكم خلال 1566- 74).وقد نسخ المصحف بخط الريحان الرائع من قبل الخطاط المعروف حسن شلبي والذي كان عبدا وبعدها تم تبنيه من قبل الخطاط المعروف أيضا أحمد قره حصاري. والمخطوطة مذهبة بشكل جميل  ومجلدة بجلد مشكل بالمكبس ومزينة بلفات من الغيوم والنباتات المزهرة.

en.name: Qur'an
description: This fine Qur’an was produced for Sokullu Mehmet Pasha, who served as Grand Vizier for two Ottoman sultans, Süleyman I (the ‘Magnificent’, r. AH 926–74 / AD 1520–66) and his successor Selim II (r. AH 974–82 / AD 1566–74). It was copied in a fine *rayhan* script by the renowned calligrapher Hasan Chelebi, who was the slave, and then adopted son, of the equally renowned calligrapher Ahmad Karahisari. The manuscript is beautifully illuminated and bound in a fine pressure-moulded binding decorated with cloud scrolls and blossoms.
keywords: koran; calligraphy; script; illumination; floral decoration; arabesque; bookbinding; Mehmet Sokolovitsch; religious manuscript
materials: Coloured pigments and gold on paper
tags: Coloured pigments and gold on paper

en.name: Pulpit
description: On the corners of the pulpit set on pillars, the figures of the evangelists are shown in high-spirited movement; between them, also plastically very highly emphasised, are *rocaille* cartouches with reliefs in which the central figure is Moses: *Moses Dancing Around the Golden Calf, Moses Receives the Law, Moses and the Bronze Serpent*. Monumentality and dynamism are the main features of the sculptural composition at the top of the baldachin too, showing the *Transfiguration of Christ on Mount Tabor*, the scene enriched with figures of the Prophets *Moses* and *Elijah* either side.
place: North wall of the church, Parish Church of Our Lady of the Snow

en.name: Reflecting circle
short_description: Reflecting circle wich belong to Portuguese Navy’s Commander Hermenegildo Capelo. It works on the principle of double reflection, like the octant and sextant, with the advantage of its limbus corresponding to a full circle, making possible the measure of angles of any amplitude. This instrument was used in the “Portuguese Scientific Expedition to the Southern Africa’s Hinterland”, in 1877.
artist: E. Lourieux (company); photo by Rui Salta
keywords: Capelo; Ivens; Expedition; Africa; Navigation

en.name: *Loie Fuller: the serpentine dance*
short_description: Mary Louise Fuller was an American dancer who lived in Europe for many years. As an artist, she was inspired by her travels and by new inventions - the dance of the veils (the "serpentine" dance) mixes Arab influences with light tricks using electricity. Loie Fuller was an important influence in the Art Nouveau and Symbolist movements, and helped train other great artists such as Isadora Duncan. The "serpentine dance" was imitated by many artists, and inspired the first cinematographers, such as the Lumière brothers, who dedicated a short film to it.
keywords: Dance; Orientalism; electricity

fr.name: *La Loïe Fuller : la danse serpentine*
short_description: Mary Louise Fuller est une danseuse américaine qui vécut plusieurs années en Europe. Cette artiste s'inspire de ses voyages et des inventions nouvelles: ainsi sa danse des voiles (la "serpentine") mélange des influences orientales et des jeux de lumière grâce à l'électricité. Loïe Fuller a influencé les mouvements artistiques de l'Art nouveau et du Symbolisme et formé des artistes brillantes comme Isadora Duncan. La "danse serpentine" a été imitée par nombre d'artistes et a inspiré les premiers cinéastes, comme les Frère Lumière qui ont lui consacré un petit film.
keywords: Danse; orientalisme; électricité

ar.name: زبدية.
description: زبدية مستديرة صغيرة من النحاس الأصفر المحزز مع شرائط من الزخارف النباتية والهندسية والكتابية، وتحت الشفة، يظهر شريط ضيق من الزخارف الملتفة، في حين تم تزيين الجسم بثلاثة أشرطة زخرفية متوضعة فوق بعضها، العلوي والسفلي منها ضيقان ويتضمنان نماذج كثيفة متشابكة مجدولة وهندسية. تتألف المنطقة بينها من أربعة إطارات متطاولة متقنة وأربع حليات دائرية تتناوب فيما بينها. تحتوي الإطارات على سعف نخل مشطورة متوضعة بشكل متناظر على كلا الجانبين مع لوحات مثلثة صغيرة تتضمن تصميماً متشابكاً وملتفاً، ويمتد الاثنان ضمن شرائط هندسية متشابكة من الأعلى والأسفل. تم ملء الإطارات بسعف النخل المشطورة الكثيفة والمتوضعة بشكل مائل والمتناوبة مع نقوش بالخط النسخي. وتذكر النقوش: "مما أمل برسم العبد الفقير الراجي عفو ربه القادر المبارك عبد المقر الكريم العالي المولوي الأمير خزندار سيف الدين برقوق". تتضمن الحليات الدائرية، ذات الامتداد الثلاثي الفصوص الذي يخترق الأشرطة ذات الزخارف الهندسية من الأعلى والأسفل، نموذجاً من الزخارف الشبكية التي تتناوب مع الشعارات المحاطة بإطار ذي زخارف ملتفة. تتضمن الشعارات ثلاث لوحات متوضعة فوق بعضها أفقياً، العلوية منها تحوي معيناً يمثل منديلاً، والوسطى كأساً مع علبة أقلام تحيط بها القرون الحاوية للمساحيق، والسفلية كأساً آخر. لقد استُعمل هذا التشكيل على الشعارات من قبل السلطان قايتباي وكذلك ضباطه واثنين من خلفائه. قد تكون هذه الزبدية الصغيرة جزءاً من حاوية طعام متعددة الطوابق كانت تحتفظ بالأطعمة المختلفة في أوعية منفصلة، وكان من الممكن أن تُقفل خوفاً من وضع السم.

تتميَّز الفترة المملوكية المتأخرة بالأواني النحاسية المُزيَّنة بالشعارات، ونقوش الثلث، التي تورد ألقاب أولياء النعمة الرسمية. ربما كان هذا الإناء الصغير عائداً إلى علبة طعام، مُتعدِّدة الطبقات (سفرطاس)، كانت تحفظ الأطعمة المختلفة، في أقسام منفصلة، كما كانت قابلة للقفل توجُّساً من احتمال دسّ السم.
holder: المتحف الملكي، المتحف الوطني في اسكتلندا NMS.
dates: أواخر القرن التاسع- أوائل العاشر/ أواخر الخامس عشر.
keywords: خط نسخ.

tags: رقائق من النحاس الأصفر المطرّق والمحزز مع بقايا تطعيم بالفضة قد يكون قد أضيف لاحقاً.

en.name: Bowl.
description: A small circular brass bowl that is incised with bands of vegetal, geometric and epigraphic bands and detailing. A narrow band of scrolling runs below the rim, while the main body is enhanced by three superposed decorative bands, the upper and lower ones of which are narrow and contain densely plaited, geometric interlaced patterning. The area in between consists of an alternating succession of four elaborate elongated cartouches and four roundels. The cartouches display symmetrically disposed split-palmette extensions on either side, together with small triangular panels containing an interlaced scroll design, both of which extend into the geometric interlace bands above and below them. The cartouches are filled with alternating, diagonally disposed, and densely set split-palmettes and inscriptions in *naskhi* script. The inscriptions read: ‘mima ‘amala bi rasm al-‘abd al-faqir al-raji ‘afwa rabihi al-qadir al-mubarak ‘abd al-muqarr al-karim al-’ali al-mawlawi al-amir khanzidar Sayf al-Din Barquq’ (This is one of the objects made for the poor servant, desirous of the forgiveness of his powerful lord, Mubarak, the servant of his high noble excellency, the high, the lordly, the Amir Khanzidar \[senior storekeeper\] al-Sayf Barquq.’). The roundels, with small trefoil extensions that pierce the geometric interlace bands above and below them, contain a pattern of alternating fretwork and composite blazons surrounded by a scrolling border. The blazon comprising three superposed horizontal panels. The upper panel contains a lozenge, symbolising a napkin; the centre panel, a cup with inscribed pen-case flanked by powder horns; and in the lower area is another cup. This particular type of composite blazon was used by Sultan Qaytbay as well as his officials and two of his successors. This little bowl may have formed part of a multi-storey food container, which kept different foods in separate compartments and – as a precaution against poisoning – could be locked.

Brassware with incised blazons and *thuluth* inscriptions giving the patron’s official titles is typical of the later Mamluk period. This little basin may have belonged to a multi-storey food box, which kept different foods in separate compartments and – as a precaution against poison – could be locked.
dates: Hegira late 9th–early 10th century / AD late 15th century.
keywords: blazon; Naskhi script; Sultan Qaytbay; domestic vessels; domestic furnishing; calligraphy; inscription
materials: Hammered and incised sheet-brass with remnants of silver inlay that is possibly a later addition.
tags: Hammered and incised sheet-brass with remnants of silver inlay that is possibly a later addition.

es.name: Cuenco
description:
Pequeño cuenco con bandas incisas de decoración vegetal, geométrica y epigráfica. Debajo del borde aparece una primera banda de roleos; de las tres restantes que decoran el cuerpo, la superior y la inferior son más estrechas y presentan un motivo geométrico trenzado, mientras que en la banda central cuatro cartuchos alargados alternan con cuatro medallones. Los cartuchos están rematados con roleos de medias palmetas a los lados y con motivos geométricos triangulares arriba y abajo; en su interior, sobre un fondo de medias palmetas, puede leerse la inscripción en letra*nasji*: *mima amala bi rasm al-abd al-faqir al-rayi afwa rabihi al-qadir al-mubarak abd al-muqarr al-karim al-ali al-mawlawi al-amir janzidar Saif al-Din Barquq* (“Este es uno de los objetos hechos para el pobre siervo que desea el perdón de su poderoso señor, Mubarak, siervo de su noble excelencia, el alto, el señorial emir jazindar \[almacenero mayor\] al-Saif Barquq”). En los medallones, rematados verticalmente por tréboles, se ve un blasón tripartido con un rombo que simboliza una servilleta (arriba), una copa con un estuche de plumas inciso y flanqueada por cuernos (centro) y otra copa (abajo). El sultán Qaytbay, sus altos funcionarios y dos de sus sucesores utilizaron este blasón.  
Este pequeño cuenco quizá era parte de un recipiente múltiple para guardar diferentes tipos de alimentos que se podría cerrar con llave (una precaución contra envenenamientos).

Los objetos de latón incisos con blasones e inscripciones con el nombre y los títulos de su propietario son típicos de finales del periodo mameluco. Tal vez este pequeño cuenco era parte de un recipiente múltiple que serviría para guardar por separado diferentes comidas y que, para evitar envenenamientos, podría cerrarse con llave.
dates: Finales del siglo IX-principios del X / finales del siglo XV d. C.
keywords: blasón; escritura nasji; sultán Qaytbay
materials: Latón batido e inciso; restos de incrustaciones de plata, posiblemente un añadido posterior.
tags: restos de incrustaciones de plata, posiblemente un añadido posterior.

fr.name: Coupe.
description: Petite coupe circulaire en cuivre jaune gravée de bandeaux et d'ornements végétaux, géométriques et épigraphiques. Une mince frise d'enroulements court sous le bord, tandis que la panse est ornée de trois bandeaux décoratifs superposés, le plus haut et le plus bas, plus étroits, contenant une dense ornementation de tresses et d'entrelacs géométriques. La zone qui les sépare présente une alternance de quatre élégants cartouches allongés et de quatre rondeaux. Les cartouches sont signalés symétriquement en partie supérieure et inférieure par des ornements en demi-palmettes et de petites formes triangulaires contenant un entrelacs de rinceaux, qui débordent tous deux sur les bandeaux d'entrelacs géométriques au-dessus et au-dessous. Les cartouches sont occupés par une composition dense de demi-palmettes alternées, disposées en diagonale, et d'inscriptions en écriture *nashki*. L'inscription précise : “Ceci est un des objets faits pour le pauvre serviteur, aspirant au pardon de son puissant seigneur, Moubarak, serviteur de sa noble altesse, son altesse, le seigneur, l'émir Khaznadar \[trésorier, responsable des coffres\] al-Sayf Barquq.” Les rondeaux à petites extensions en forme de trèfle qui transpercent les bandeaux d'entrelacs géométriques supérieurs et inférieurs contiennent un motif alterné de découpes et de blasons composites entouré d'une bordure de rinceaux. Ce blason comprend trois panneaux superposés. Le panneau supérieur contient un losange, symbolisant une serviette, celui du centre, une coupe à plumier flanqué de cornes à poudre et en partie inférieure une autre coupe. Ce type particulier de blason composite fut utilisé par le sultan Qaytbay ainsi que par ses hauts fonctionnaires et deux de ses successeurs. Cette petite coupe a pu faire partie d'un porte-dîner à plusieurs niveaux, qui permettait de conserver les aliments dans des compartiments séparés et qui – précaution contre les empoisonnements –, pouvait être fermé à clé.

Les objets en laiton gravés de blasons et d’inscriptions *toulouth* donnant les titres officiels du donateur sont typiques de la fin de la période mamelouke. Cette petite coupe a pu faire partie d’un porte-dîner à plusieurs niveaux, qui permettait de conserver les aliments dans des compartiments séparés et qui – précaution contre les empoisonnements – pouvait être fermé à clé.
dates: Fin IXe, début Xe siècle de l’Hégire (fin XVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: blason ; écriture nashki ; sultan Qaytbay
materials: Feuille de cuivre martelé et incisé, traces d’incrustations d’argent, peut-être tardives.
tags: Feuille de cuivre martelé et incisé, traces d’incrustations d’argent, peut-être tardives.

en.name: Library museum
partner: National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Art

de.name: Pfeilerarkade und Abseite
description: Die Gliederung der großen Pfeiler im Hauptraum entspricht der Bauweise von Wandpfeilern in Längsbauten. Die Kanten sind mit Pilastern besetzt, die ein kräftiges verkröpftes Gebälk tragen. Über einer Attikazone erheben sich die Gurtbögen, die die Stirne der tonnengewölbten Abseiten markieren. Die hintere Abschlusswand mit großem Rundbogenfenster ist nur eine reine Füllwand, ohne architektonische Gliederung. Anschaulich bilden Pilaster und Gurtbögen acht voll ausgebildete Arkaden, die den Mittelraum wie ein Kranz umgeben und ihn nach allen Seiten torartig öffnen.

en.name: Pier arcades and aisle
description: The arrangement of large columns in the main space corresponds to pilaster-type constructions in longitudinal buildings. The edges are occupied by pilasters supporting a powerful entablature bent at right angles. The vault arches ascend above an attic zone and mark the ends of the barrel-vaulted aisles. The rear wall with a large, round arched window functions solely as a panel wall without architectural structure. Pilasters and vault arches generate eight fully formed arcades which encircle the central space like a crown, opening up on all sides like gateways.
place: Main room, view into the aisle

en.name: Palace of the Marquis of Zenete
description:
The itinerary finishes with the property that belonged to Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, Marquis of Zenete, which remained in the family until 1662, when it was converted into a hospital for patients with ringworm. Its palace structure complies with the characteristics of the original Islamic building, which was transformed in the 16th century. A forecourt covered by a simple *alfarje* leads us onto a courtyard of spacious dimensions in which the rhythm of the lower level is arranged by columns from the ancient Nasrid building, providing the basis for the Mannerist lintels. The upper floor has balustrades, piers turned in the style of Ionic columns, and lintels, which repeat the design of the lower ones, although now smaller.  
Recent excavations have uncovered the various historical sequences of the building, thus allowing appropriate understanding and appreciation of its artistic and historical value.  
In the Nasrid palace belonging to the reigning dynasty, Boabdil was acclaimed monarch for the second time in 1482, after he had taken refuge in the Alcazaba. In the hands of the Marquis of Zenete, the building became another example of the symbiosis between the Muslims and the Christians. Its new owner, being a man of his time, lived astride the two cultures, and this, definitively, is what we recognise as Mudéjar.

es.name: Palacio del marqués del Zenete
description:
Nuestro recorrido termina con este edificio, que perteneció a Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, marqués del Zenete, y estuvo en manos de su linaje hasta que en 1662 se convirtió en hospital para tiñosos. Responde a las características palaciegas propias del edificio islámico original, transformado en el siglo XVI. A través de un zaguán, cubierto con un simple *alfarje*, llegamos a un patio de grandes dimensiones en el que destacan las columnas del piso inferior. Procedentes de la antigua construcción nazarí que precedió al edificio, sobre ellas apoyan zapatas de traza manierista. La planta superior presenta balaustradas y pies derechos torneados a modo de columnas jónicas, y zapatas que repiten el diseño de las bajas, aunque de menor escuadría.  
Recientes excavaciones van dando a conocer las distintas secuencias históricas del edificio, cuyo valor patrimonial esperamos ver pronto magnificado.  
En el palacio nazarí, perteneciente a la dinastía reinante, fue reconocido Boabdil por segunda vez monarca en 1482, cuando se refugió en la Alcazaba. En manos del marqués del Zenete se convirtió en una nueva muestra de simbiosis entre lo musulmán y lo cristiano. Su nuevo señor, hombre de su época, vivía a caballo de las dos culturas, y eso es lo que, en definitiva, conocemos como mudéjar.

ar.name: طست.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن طست عميق من النحاس المكفت بالفضة يزخرفه شريط كتابي بخط الثلث نصه " مما عمل برسم المقر الأشرف العالي المولوي العالمي العادلي الغازي المجاهدي المخدومي السيفي طبطق الملكي الأشرفي." ويرجع الاسم الذي يحمله الطست إلى الأمير طبطق، وهو من أمراء الملك الأشرف خليل الذي حكم في الفترة 689 – 693 هـ / 1290 – 1294 م. وكان طبطق حاكماً لمدينة قوص في صعيد مصر أثناء فترة الحكم الثالثة للسلطان الناصر محمد بن قلاوون (709 - 741هـ / 1309-1340 م). ويتخلل الكتابة عدة شعارات ( رنوك) تتكون من رسم كأس يرمز إلى وظيفة الساقي. ويتوسط قاع الطست من الداخل زخرفة تتكون من ست أسماك أخذت وضعاً حلزونياً حول مركز الطست.  
  
ويستخدم الطست لغسل الأيدي وأحياناً لغسل الملابس. وقد عرفت خزانة الكسوة في العصر المملوكي بـ "الطست خاناه"، وتعني بيت الطست، وكان يحفظ بها كل ما يخص السلطان من طسوت وثياب وجواهر وسيوف ومقاعد وسجاد. وتنوعت أشكال الطسوت وأساليب زخرفتها وتكفيتها بالذهب والفضة خاصة في العصر المملوكي.

استخدمت الطسوت مع الأباريق في عملية غسل الأيدي والملابس والنظافة، بصفة عامة. ويتميز هذا الطست النحاسي المكفَّت بالذهب، بالإضافة إلى جمال زخارفه ونقوشه، بأنه يحمل رنك، أو شعار صاحبه (الساقي)، الأمير طبطق، وهو يكوّن طاقماً مع الإبريق، الذي يحمل اسم الأمير نفسه.
keywords: تكفيت؛ خط؛ خط الثلث؛ طست؛ نحاس.

en.name: Basin.
description:
This piece, a deep copper basin inlaid with silver, is decorated with an epigraphic band written in *thuluth* script whose text reads: 'Made for the honourable Excellency, the sublime master, the learned, the just, the warrior (of the frontiers), the defender (of the faith), the masterful, al-Sayfi Tabtaq al-Maliki al-Ashrafi.' The name carried by this vessel is linked to Amir Tabtaq, one of the officers under al-Malik al-Ashraf Khalil, who ruled from AH 689–93 / AD 1290–4. Tabtaq was the governor of Qus a city in Upper Egypt, during the third reign of Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun (AH 709–41 / AD 1309–40). A number of blazons depicting a goblet, a symbol for the position of cupbearer, intermingle with the inscriptions. The inside centre base of the basin holds a design composed of six fishes arranged in a spiral format.  
The basin was used for hand-washing and at times for washing clothes. During the Mamluk period, the wardrobe or storeroom for clothing was known as '*tast khana*' meaning the 'abode of the basin' and all that was allotted to the sultans by way of basins, apparel, jewellery, swords, chairs and carpets was stored there. There were various types of basin and a variety of decorative styles, including gold and silver inlay, especially during the Mamluk period.
A basin would form a pair with a ewer as an indispensable item in hand-washing and cleanliness in general. This basin, inlaid with silver, bears the blazon of its owner, the cupbearer Amir Tabtaq.
keywords: Inlay; thuluth; copper; blazon

es.name: Jofaina.
description:
Esta pieza, una jofaina de cobre bastante honda con incrustaciones de plata, está decorada con una banda epigráfica en letra *zuluz*, que reza: "Hecho para la honorable Excelencia, el sublime señor, el erudito, el justo, el guerrero (de las fronteras), el defensor (de la fe), el imperioso, al-Sayfi Tabtaq al-Maliki al-Ashrafi". El nombre que aparece en este recipiente está relacionado con el emir Tabtaq, uno de los oficiales a las órdenes de al-Malik al-Ashraf Jalil (r. 689-693 / 1290-1294). Tabtaq fue gobernador de la ciudad de Qus en el Alto Egipto durante el tercer sultanato de al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun (709-741 / 1309-1340). Entre las inscripciones se aprecian varios blasones en los que aparece representada una copa, el símbolo del cargo de copero. En su interior, el centro de la base está decorado con un dibujo de seis peces que forman una espiral.  
La jofaina se utilizaba para lavarse las manos y lavar ropa. Durante el periodo mameluco, el guardarropa o vestidor se conocía como *tast jana*, que significa 'lugar de la jofaina', y todos los objetos que se entregaban a los sultanes, como jofainas, ropajes, joyas, espadas, sillones y alfombras, se almacenaban allí. Había varios tipos de jofainas, con muchos estilos decorativos distintos, a veces en incrustaciones de oro y plata.

Las jofainas se empleaban junto con los aguamaniles, utensilios indispensables para lavarse las manos y para la limpieza en general. Esta jofaina de cobre con incrustaciones de oro lleva el blasón de su propietario, el emir copero Tabtaq.
dates: Siglo VIII de la Hégira / XIV d. C.
keywords: Incrustación; escritura zuluz; jofaina; cobre; blasón.

fr.name: Bassin.
description:
Bassin en cuivre incrusté d'argent décoré d'un bandeau épigraphique en écriture *thoulouth* se lisant : “Fait pour l'honorable Excellence, le maître sublime, le savant, le juste, le combattant (des frontières), le défenseur (de la foi), l'impérieux, al-Sayfi Tabtaq al-Maliki al-Achrafi.” Il s'agit de l'émir Tabtaq, l'un des grands dignitaires de al-Malik al-Achraf Khalil (r. 689-693 H / 1290-1294 J.-C.), gouverneur de Qus, ville de Haute-égypte, au cours du troisième règne du sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun (709-741 H / 1309-1340 J.-C.). Plusieurs blasons à gobelet, symbole de sa charge d'échanson, interrompent l'inscription. L'intérieur du fond du bassin est orné d'un dessin représentant six poissons en spirale.  
Ce type de bassin servait à se laver les mains, et parfois les vêtements. Pendant la période mamelouke, la garde-robe ou pièce de rangement était appelée *Tast Khana*, ce qui signifie “lieu du bassin”. Bassins, vêtements, bijoux, épées, fauteuils et tapis y étaient rangés.  
Plusieurs types de bassins et de styles décoratifs (dont des modèles à incrustations d'or et d'argent) existaient au cours de la période mamelouke.

Le bassin et l'aiguière formaient une paire d'accessoires indispensables pour se laver les mains et pour l'hygiène en général. Ce bassin, incrusté d'argent, porte le blason de son propriétaire, l'émir Tabtaq, échanson.
dates: VIIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Incrustations ; écriture thoulouth ; bassins ; cuivre ; blasons

en.name: Castle
description:
The walls of Beja are the longest in the Baixo Alentejo and have largely retained the structure that they had in the reign of D. Manuel I. They began with a Roman camp and were significantly enlarged during the Moorish occupation, but were largely destroyed by attacks by Christian troops. Restoration began in the 14th century and continued into the 15th century, when the Islamic fortress was entirely reconstructed and the 40-m.-high keep was built. Extensive restoration work was carried out in 1939.  
The fortress and walls are easily distinguished, the latter enclosing the old Manueline part of the city with the main churches, such as the Igreja de Santa Maria, Igreja de Santiago and the Convento de Nossa Senhora da Conceição. Oval in shape, the walls had almost 40 towers, as well as dry moats and various gateways: Porta de Moura, Porta de Beja, Porta de Avis, Porta de Aljustrel and others, as well as wicket gates. The walls are high and strong with battlements and parapets all the way round.  
The castle is pentagonal in shape and the parade ground contains the commander’s residence, heavily restored and containing Manueline architectural features originating from demolition work carried out in other parts of the city, though it is clear from old photographs that the windows and arches on the façade are original.  
The 15th-century keep, with three floors and vaulted ceilings, stands at one of the corners.The middle floor with its stellar vaulting, one of the finest and most complex of the Portuguese Gothic, is of particular interest. The upper part of the tower with its surrounding terrace and ample *machicolations* is also noteworthy.

en.name: Portrait of Shakir Shukayr
short_description: Shakir Shukayr was born in 1850 in Choueifat. He received his primary education here, before moving to the Orthodox School in Suq al-Gharb. He was tutored in Arabic by Shaykh Nasif al-Yaziji, and became a professor first at the Three Doctors School and then at the National School. In 1868 he became a member of the Syriac Scientific Association. Author of numerous books, he died in October 1896.
keywords: Teacher; Tutorship; College

en.name: *Servet-i Fünun* Journal
short_description: This is a magazine published by the authors from the *Servet-ı Fünun* (*Edebiyat-ı Cedide*) movement. It was first published as a scientific magazine by Ahmet İhsan Tokgöz, a pupil of Recaizade Mahmud Ekrem, in 1891. Recaizade Mahmud Ekrem agreed with his pupil to turn this magazine into one of literature, so he arranged that Tevfik Fikret, another student of his from Galatasaray High school, would become head of the literature department. This movement came to an end when the magazine was closed after if published an article entitled “Literature and Justice,” translated by Hüseyin Cahit Yalçın, which was taken as hostile to the governance of Abdülhamid II. Members of the *Edebiyat-ı Cedide* movement remained adherent to Diwan literature due to the political situation of the period as well as political suppression. They were not as open to novelties as the first generation of Tanzimat Era and they adopted art for sake of art.
partner: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (General Directorate for Cultural Heritage and Museums)

en.name: Women by the Well
description:
This painting elegantly encapsulates a quotidian moment imbued with the rural essence of Jordanian tradition. The scene under consideration depicts a group of figures, predominantly female, congregated around a stone well situated beneath a clear blue sky, with lush greenery and palm trees serving as a backdrop. The utilisation of vibrant hues and meticulous attention to detail serves to elicit a sense of concord between humans, architecture and nature.  
The composition is centred on the well structure, which is composed of warm, sandy stones and framed by an arched entrance that serves as both a practical and symbolic focal point. This concept encompasses not only the physical source of water but also serves as a nexus for community and social interaction. The women's actions, drawing, carrying and pouring water reflect cooperation and rhythm in everyday life, while their vibrant clothing, rich in blues, reds and greens, highlights cultural identity and regional craftsmanship.  
The artist's employment of colour and light engenders an atmosphere that is serene and almost celebratory. The distinct contours and vivid colour scheme bear resemblance to folk painting and naïve art, placing emphasis on storytelling and collective memory as opposed to strict realism. This approach encourages viewers to recognise the aesthetic value of simplicity and to acknowledge the dignity of routine activities.
holder: Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts
keywords: women; well; water; oil
partner: Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts

ar.name: مطبوعة
description:
تصور هذه المطبوعة النحاسية المحمل الاحتفالي في موكب الحج من القاهرة إلى مكة خلال شهر الحج. والمحمل هو قماش يشبه الخيام يغطي فضلات الإبل ويحمل الكسوة الجديدة التي تُمنح على الكعبة المشرفة.  
  
بتاريخ 1729 في ليدن ، طبع الناشر الهولندي بيتر فان دير آ هذا الرسم التوضيحي للقافلة الدينية التي كانت تسافر إلى المملكة العربية السعودية مع الحجاج المسلمين. تجلب الصورة الحج إلى الحياة ، وتشير الملصقات إلى العناصر الفردية ، بما في ذلك القائد وزوجته اللذين يتم حملهما داخل البالانكوين.  
  
نظرًا لأن المصلين في جميع أنحاء العالم يتقدمون للحصول على تأشيرة الحج ، فقد تعكس هذه المطبوعة أهمية الحج بالنسبة للمسلمين الهولنديين اليوم ، بينما تحيي المعارض المعاصرة في هولندا ذكرى هذا الركن من أركان الإسلام.
holder: متحف الشيخ فيصل بن قاسم ال ثاني
partner: متحف الشيخ فيصل بن قاسم ال ثاني

en.name: Mahmal Print
description:
This copper print depicts the ceremonial *mahmal* in the pilgrimage procession from Cairo to Mecca during the month of *hajj*. The *mahmal* is a tent-like cloth covering the camel litter and bearing the new *kiswa* to be bestowed upon the Kaaba.  
  
Dated 1729 in Leiden, the Dutch publisher Pieter van der Aa printed this illustration of the religious caravan traveling to Saudi Arabia with Muslim pilgrims. The picture brings the pilgrimage to life and labels indicate the individual elements, including the commander and his wife who are carried within the palanquin.  
  
As worshippers around the world apply for the *hajj* visa, this print may reflect the importance of the pilgrimage for Dutch Muslims today, while contemporary exhibitions in the Netherlands commemorate this pillar of Islam.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani
keywords: Saudi Arabia; Kiswa; Kaaba; Mahmal; Mecca; Prints
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

en.name: Library
description:
A significant Enlightenment Library with around 36,000 volumes amassed through royal commission. It has a cruciform layout with a multi-coloured limestone floor and Rocaille shelves.  
Some rare works furnish its shelves to this day: the *Nuremberg Chronicle* (1493) or the *Theatrvm Orbis Terrarvm* by Ortelius (1595) and a nucleus of scores from musicians such as João de Sousa Carvalho or Marcos Portugal, composed expressly to be played on the Basilica's six organs.
partner: Institute for the Administration of Architectural and Archaeological Heritage -  IGESPAR

pt.name: Biblioteca
description: Importante biblioteca das Luzes, com cerca de 36.000 volumes. Cruciforme, possui um pavimento em mármore policromo e estantes r*ocaille.* O seu acervo inclui obras tão raras como a *Crónica de Nuremberga* (1493) ou *Theatrvm Orbis Terrarvm*, de Ortelius (1595), além de um núcleo de partituras escritas para os seis órgãos da Basílica por músicos como João de Sousa Carvalho ou Marcos Portugal.

de.name: Tugenden und Lobpreis Gottes
description: An den elegant gekurvten Brüstungen der doppelgeschossigen Empore sind allegorische Darstellungen angebracht. Am ersten, für Gläubige reservierten  Geschoss werden zu Seiten einer Allegorie der Kirche die Kardinaltugenden Weisheit, Mäßigkeit, Tapferkeit und Gerechtigkeit gezeigt, ergänzt durch Glaube, Liebe und Hoffnung an der Emporenunterseite. Die Bildthematik des oberen Geschosses bezieht sich passend zur Nutzung als Orgelempore auf den Lobpreis Gottes durch musizierende Engel. Zum Kontext gehören als Teil der Deckenfresken die hl. Cäcilia, König David sowie der Prophet Jeremias.

en.name: Virtues and Praise of God
description: Allegorical representations are mounted on the elegantly curved balustrades of the two-storey gallery. On the first floor, reserved for the faithful, the cardinal virtues of wisdom, temperance, courage and justice are shown as aspects of an allegory of the church, complemented by faith, love and hope on the underside of the gallery. The pictorial theme of the upper storey, appropriately as an organ gallery, refers to the praise of God by angels making music. As part of the ceiling frescoes, the context includes St. Cecelia, King David and the Prophet Jeremiah.
partner: University of Munich, Institute of Art History

ar.name: وعاء خزفي ميناي
description: وعاء دائري له قاعدة دائرية صغيرة، سطحه الداخلي مزين بأشكال لأربعة أزواج من الأشخاص يرتدون ملابس ملونة بينهم أشجار سرو صغيرة مدببة، وفي منتصف قاعدة الوعاء شكل لفارس يمتطي حصانه.  يزين شريط من الكتابات الحافة الداخلية للوعاء، بينما يزين الحافة الخارجية شريط أزرق وأحمر اللون.
dates: أواخر القرن السادس-أوائل القرن السابع الهجري/ أواخر القرن الثاني عشر-أوائل القرن الثالث عشر الميلادي

en.name: Mina'I bowl
description: A typically round bowl sitting on a short circular foot. The interior is decorated with pairs of seated figures dressed in brightly coloured clothes separated by small pointed cypress trees with a man on horseback in the centre. Below the rim on the inside is a calligraphic band whilst on the exterior is a red and blue decoration.
dates: Late 6th-early 7th century AH / Late 12th-early 13th century AD

ar.name: مسجد قرطبة.
description:
جامع قرطبة نتاج لسلسلة من الإضافات والترميمات التي توالت منذ بداية بنائه خلال الفترة الأميرية حتى سقوط الخلافة.  
وبالرغم من أن الإحالات الأولى جاءت مضطربة، فقد انطلقت الأعمال حوالي عام 169 / 785 – 786 ، خلال إمارة عبد الرحمن الأول. بعد ذلك، تدخل تقريباً كل الأمراء وكل الخلفاء في المسجد الجامع للعاصمة. شُيد هذا الأخير فوق كنيسة قوطية قديمة، وكان المسجد الأول عبارة عن بناية مربعة تتألف من صحن وقاعة مسقوفة للصلاة. قُسِّمت هذه الأخيرة بواسطة عشرة صفوف من العقود إلى 11 بلاطة متعامدة مع جدار القبلة الذي ينفتح في وسطه محراب بسيط. ومن أبرز مميزات هذا المعبد الأول استعمالُ وسيلة تمثلت في مضاعفة العقود من أجل إعطاء ارتفاع أكبر للقاعة؛ وتقوم هذه العقود المتراكبة بتناوب فقرات الحجارة البيضاء مع أخرى من الآجر الأحمر. وبالرغم من أن المادة المستخدمة كانت مستعملة ومسحوبة من بنايات رومانية وقوطية، ومنقولة إلى عين المكان، فإن الأعمال قد دامت سنوات عديدة، وتم إنهاء البناية على يد الخليفة هشام الأول.  
يتمثل التوسيعُ الأول للمسجد، خلال فترة عبد الرحمن الثاني، في تمديد قاعة الصلاة نحو الجنوب، وتحويل حائط القبلة حوالي 26 متراً، مع مراعاة ارتفاع البناية الأولى. وخلال هذه العملية، ظهرت التيجان الأولى المصنوعة بإتقان إلى جانب تلك التي أعيد استعمالها حتى الآن. وقد جرى إنهاء الأشغال في عهد محمد الأول، الذي أتم المقصورة ورمم باب القديس إستبان؛ ثم شيد ولداه، المنذر وعبد الرحمن الثالث، على التوالي، بيت المال والساباط.  
في القرن الرابع/ العاشر، شرع عبد الرحمن الثالث، الخليفة الأموي الأول، في تشييد حائط الدخول إلى قاعة الصلاة، وتوسيع الصحن الذي أسندت عليه مئذنة جديدة، ولازال جزؤها السفلي ماثلاً للعيان داخل برج الأجراس بالكاتدرائية.  
لكن أهم توسيع عرفه الجامع كان في عهد الحكم الثاني، خليفة عبد الرحمن الثالث، مباشرة عند اعتلائه عرش الخلافة. فجرى من جديد تمديد أقواس قاعة الصلاة نحو الجنوب، وإنهاؤها بمقصورة ضخمة، وبالتالي بناء حائط القبلة الحالي، وأبواب الخزينة والساباط. ويبقى هذا المجال، بالزخرفة الفسيفسائية الغنية والبنية الرقيقة للدعامات المعمارية، الفضاء الأكثر إثارة والأكثر رمزية في المسجد. كما تشكل القباب التي لازال خمس منها قائمة بالمكان عينه عنصراً آخر أُدخِلَ في الفترة نفسها؛ وتبقى القبة المتواجدة أمام المحراب على وجه الخصوص جميلة بفضل لوحاتها الفسيفسائية.  
وفي نهاية القرن الرابع/ العاشر، خلال فترة حكم هشام الثاني، وتحت حكم حاجب قرطبة القوي، المنصور، انطلقت أعمال التوسيع الرئيسية الأخيرة للمبنى. وأمام استحالة توسيع المسجد مرة أخرى باتجاه الجنوب، تم اختيار الزيادة فيه من جهة الشرق بإضافة ثمان بلاطات، مع مراعاة الارتفاع السابق لقاعة الصلاة والصحن، وبقي المحراب ومقصورة الحكم الثاني سليمان، ولكنهما منذئذ لم يعودا متواجدين في وسط حائط القبلة.

كان هذا الجامع أهم مسجد بالغرب الإسلامي. وكما نعرفه اليوم، فهو نتيجة لسلسلة من التوسعات الممولة من قبل الأمراء والخلفاء الأمويين، الذين حققوا الشرعية لسلطتهم، ونجحوا بالتالي في الزيادة في الطاقة الاستيعابية للمسجد التي جعل منها تكاثر الساكنة أمرا ضروريا. وقد تم الحصول على الوحدة الفضائية لقاعة الصلاة الفخمة (التي تبلغ مساحتها 12000 متر مربع) بإعادة النسق – العبقري – للعقود المزدوجة، التي ترتكز على أعمدة مرتبة على شكل بلاطات متعامدة مع جدار القبلة، وتخلق فاعلية غابة نخيل. كما تم إتمام المجموعة بالمقصورة والمحراب، المزخرفين زخرفة رائعة.
artist: عبد الرحمن الأول (حكم مابين 139 – 172 / 756 – 788)؛ هشام الأول (حكم مابين 171 – 179 / 788 – 796)؛ عبد الرحمن الثاني (حكم مابين 207 – 238 / 822 – 852) محمد الأول (حكم مابين 237 – 272 / 852 – 886)؛ المنذر (حكم مابين 272 – 274 / 886 – 888)؛ عبد الله (حكم مابين 274 – 299 / 888 – 912)؛ عبد الرحمن الثالث (حكم مابين 299 – 350 / 912 – 961)؛ الحكم الثاني (حكم مابين 350 – 366 / 961 – 976)؛ أبو عامر المنصور (حكم مابين 367 – 392 / 978 – 1002).
history: في 29 حزيران/ يونيو 1236 (19 شوال من عام 633) افتُتحتْ مدينةُ قرطبة على يد فرديناند الثالث، القديس. وفي العام نفسه، جرى تطهير المسجد وتكريسه ككنيسة مسيحية. وابتداءاً من القرن العاشر/ السادس عشر بدأت في داخل المسجد أشغال كاتدرائية سانتا ماريا (القديسة مريم) التي ترتفع حاليا وسط قاعة الصلاة.

en.name: Great Mosque of Córdoba.
description:
The mosque at Córdoba is the result of a series of extensions and modifications that have been carried out since its construction, during the time of the amirs until the fall of the Caliphate.  
Although early references are confused, work must have begun around AH 169 / AD 785–6 during the Emirate of 'Abd al-Rahman I and almost all of the Umayyad amirs and caliphs subsequently worked on the capital's great mosque.  
The original building, which was placed on the site of an old Visigothic church, was a square enclosure that included a courtyard and a roofed prayer room. This room had ten arcades that divided it into 11 naves perpendicular to the *qibla* wall, where there was a simple *mihrab* (prayer niche). The most characteristic element of this first temple was the decision to place a second arcade above the first to increase the height of the room. The voussoirs of the arches alternate between white stone and red brick. Although the material used was salvaged from Roman and Visigothic buildings and not sourced locally, the work lasted several years and the building was completed by Hisham I.  
The mosque was first expanded during the time of 'Abd al-Rahman II, when the prayer room was enlarged to the south and the *qibla* wall was moved 26 metres, without, however, altering the elevation of the original building. For the first time, specially produced capitals were used along with salvaged ones. The works were completed by Muhammad I, who finished the *maqsura* (sanctuary for imam or caliph) and restored St Stephen's Gate (puerta de San Esteban). His sons al-Mundhir and 'Abdallah built the treasure room and the *sabat* (covered passageway) respectively.  
In the AH 4th / AD 10th century, 'Abd al-Rahman III, the first caliph of the dynasty, began the reconstruction of the wall of the entrance to the prayer room and the expansion of the courtyard, beside which he built a new minaret, the lower part of which is preserved as part of the existing bell tower of the cathedral.  
The largest expansion was started soon after al-Hakam II succeeded 'Abd al-Rahman III to the Caliphate. Again the arcades in the prayer room were extended southwards, terminating in a monumental *maqsura*, and the existing *qibla* wall was erected with the *mihrab* and doors to the treasury and *sabat*. The rich mosaic decoration, pieces of sculpted marble and intertwined arches, as well as the delicate sculpting of the architectural supports, make this the most spectacular and emblematic part of the mosque. The cupolas, of which five have survived, were also added at this time. The mosaics in the cupola in front of the *mihrab* make it particularly beautiful.  
Towards the end of the AH 4th / AD 10th century, during the time of Hisham II and under the governance of the powerful *hajib* of Córdoba, al-Mansur, the last and greatest expansion of the building was started. As the mosque could not be enlarged any further to the south, it was decided to enlarge it to the east with eight new naves. The existing elevation of the room and the courtyard, which had also been expanded, was left unchanged, as were the *mihrab* and the *maqsura* of al-Hakam II, although they were no longer at the centre of the *qibla* wall.

The most important in the Muslim West, the mosque that we know today is the result of successive extensions financed by Umayyad amirs and caliphs to consolidate their power and create capacity for a growing population. The space inside the majestic prayer room (totalling 12,000m2) is made possible through the repeated use of an ingenious system of double arches on columns organised into naves that run perpendicular to the *qibla* wall, creating the effect of a forest of palm trees. The room also has a *maqsura* (sanctuary for imam) and a *mihrab* (prayer niche), both sumptuously decorated.
dynasty: Umayyad of al-Andalus, Emirate and Caliphate periods.
artist: ‘Abd al-Rahman I (r. AH 139–72 / AD 756–88); Hisham I (r. AH 171–9 / AD 788–96); ‘Abd al-Rahman II (r. AH 207–38 / AD 822–52); Muhammad I (r. AH 237–72 / AD 852–86); al-Mundir (r. AH 272–4 / AD 886–8); ‘Abdallah (r. AH 274–99 / AD 888–912); ‘Abd al-Rahman III (r. AH 299–350 / AD 912–61); al-Hakam II (r. AH 350–66 / AD 961–76); Abi Amir al-Mansur (r. AH 367–92 / AD 978–1002).
history: On 29 June 1236 (19 Shawwal 633), the city of Córdoba was conquered by Ferdinand III the Holy. In the same year the Great Mosque was purified and consecrated as a Christian church. In the 10th / 16th century, construction began within the mosque on the Cathedral of Santa Maria, which currently stands in the middle of the prayer room.

es.name: Mezquita Mayor.
description:
La mezquita de Córdoba es resultado de una serie de ampliaciones y reformas que, desde su construcción en época emiral hasta la caída del califato, fueron yuxtaponiéndose.  
  
Aunque las primeras referencias son confusas, las obras debieron de iniciarse en torno a 169 H. / 785-86 d. C., durante el emirato de Abd al-Rahman I. Luego, casi todos los emires y califas omeyas intervinieron en la mezquita aljama de la capital.  
  
El edifico inicial, asentado sobre una antigua iglesia visigoda, era un recinto cuadrado que incluía un patio y una sala de oración techada. Ésta tenía diez arquerías que la dividían en once naves perpendiculares al muro de la *qibla*, donde había un sencillo *mihrab*. Lo más característico de este primer templo es la solución de doblar los arcos en su alzado para dar mayor altura a la sala. Los arcos superpuestos alternan las dovelas de piedra blanca con las de ladrillo rojo. Pese a que el material empleado fue de acarreo, reutilizado de edificios romanos y visigodos, las obras duraron varios años y el edificio fue terminado por Hisam I.  
  
La primera ampliación de la mezquita se hizo en época de Abd al-Rahman II, cuando se alargó la sala de oración hacia el sur y se desplazó el muro de la *qibla* unos 26 m, aunque respetando el alzado de la primitiva obra. Aparecen entonces los primeros capiteles fabricados *ex profeso* junto a los reutilizados. La obra fue rematada por Muhammad I, quien terminó la *maqsura* y restauró la puerta de San Esteban. Sus hijos al-Mundir y Abd Allah construyeron lasala del tesoro y el *sabat* respectivamente.  
  
En el siglo IV H./ X d.C., Abd al-Rahman III, primer califa de la dinastía, emprendió la reconstrucción del muro de entrada a la sala de oración y la ampliación del patio, al que adosó un nuevo alminar, cuya parte inferior se conserva en el actual campanario de la catedral.  
  
La mayor ampliación se inició nada más acceder al califato al-Hakam II, sucesor de Abd al-Rahman III. De nuevo se prolongaron en dirección sur las arquerías de la sala de oración, rematadas en una monumental *maqsura*, y se levantó el actual muro de la *qibla*, con el *mihrab* y las puertas del tesoro y el *sabat*. La rica decoración de mosaicos, placas de mármol tallado y arcos entrecruzados, y la delicada talla de los soportes arquitectónicos convierten esta parte en la más espectacular y emblemática de la mezquita. Las cúpulas, de las que se conservan cinco, son otro elemento introducido en ese momento; especialmente bella, por sus mosaicos, es la situada frente al *mihrab*.  
  
A fines del siglo IV H./ X d. C., en época de Hisam II, bajo la administración del poderoso *hajib* de Córdoba al-Mansur, empezó la última y gran ampliación del edificio. Ante la imposibilidad de ampliar más la mezquita hacia el sur, se optó por agrandarla al este con ocho nuevas naves. Se respetó el alzado anterior de la sala y el patio, también ampliado, y no se tocaron ni el *mihrab* ni la *maqsura* de al-Hakam II, que quedaron desplazadosdel centro del muro de la *qibla*.

Fue la más importante del Occidente musulmán. Tal como la conocemos, es resultado de sucesivas ampliaciones financiadas por los emires y califas omeyas, que legitimaron así su poder, además de resolver la necesidad de mayor cabida para una población creciente. La unidad espacial de la majestuosa sala de oraciones (de 12.000 m²) se consiguió mediante la repetición del genial sistema de arquerías dobles sobre columnas que, organizadas en naves perpendiculares a la *qibla*, producen el efecto de un bosque de palmeras. El conjunto se completa con la *maqsura* y el *mihrab*, suntuosamente ornamentados.
dynasty: Omeyas de al-Andalus, periodos emiral y califal.
history: El 29 de junio de 1236 (19 de shawwal de 633 H.), la ciudad de Córdoba fue conquistada por Fernando III el Santo. Ese mismo año la gran mezquita fue purificada y se consagró como templo cristiano. A partir del siglo X H. / XVI d.C., se inicia en el interior de la mezquita la construcción de la catedral de Santa María, que actualmente se levanta en el centro de la sala de oración.
